<meta name="theme-color" content="#0F1A2C">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<title>İŞLETMEM</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://www.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;700&family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@600;700&family=Dancing+Script:wght@600;700&family=Lobster&family=Montserrat:wght@500;700&family=Oswald:wght@500;600&family=Pacifico&family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&family=Poppins:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" media="print" onload="this.media='all'">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" media="print" onload="this.media='all'">
<noscript><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"></noscript>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg: #f4f2f0;
    --panel: #ffffff;
    --panel-2: #fafafa;
    --ink: #26221f;
    --ink-dim: #6b6560;
    --ink-faint: #9b948c;
    --line: #e8e4df;
    --red: #cf2e2e;
    --red-dark: #a92222;
    --sidebar-active: #ececec;
    --shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
    --card-orange-1:#f7a94a; --card-orange-2:#f08a2a;
    --card-blue-1:#4ec3e0; --card-blue-2:#1f8fc4;
    --card-green-1:#8fc23e; --card-green-2:#4f9130;
    --sage:#2f8f5b; --card-pink-1:#e2437a; --card-pink-2:#c22357;
  }
  [data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg: #15130f;
    --panel: #1e1a15;
    --panel-2: #241f19;
    --ink: #f1e9de;
    --ink-dim: #b3a999;
    --ink-faint: #7d7364;
    --line: #332b21;
    --sidebar-active: #2a241d;
    --shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  *{ box-sizing:border-box; }
  html,body{ margin:0; padding:0; height:100%; }
  body{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--ink);
    transition: background .25s ease, color .25s ease;
  }

  /* global interaction polish */
  button, .link-btn, .btn-mini, .btn-save, .btn-pay, .btn-add, .btn-update,
  .nav-item, .sub-item, .stat-card, .table-cell, .plain-table-cell, .sm-pill,
  .product-card, .mp-chip, .order-type-card, .pp-method, .tab, .region-tab,
  .sm-switch-btn, .cat-item, .chart-card{
    transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, transform .1s ease;
  }
  button:active, .btn-mini:active, .btn-save:active, .btn-pay:active, .btn-add:active,
  .sm-pill:active, .plain-table-cell:active, .mp-chip:active, .order-type-card:active{
    transform: scale(0.98);
  }
  .stat-card:hover, .chart-card:hover{ box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
  [data-theme="dark"] .stat-card:hover, [data-theme="dark"] .chart-card:hover{ box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }

  /* eye-comfort toggle */
  .eye-toggle{
    position: fixed; top: 14px; right: 14px; z-index: 500;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    background: var(--panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 7px 12px 7px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--ink-dim);
    user-select: none;
  }
  .eye-toggle .icon{ font-size: 15px; line-height:1; }
  .eye-toggle .track{
    width: 34px; height: 18px; border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--line); position: relative; transition: background .2s;
  }
  .eye-toggle .knob{
    position:absolute; top:2px; left:2px; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%;
    background: var(--red); transition: left .2s;
  }
  [data-theme="dark"] .eye-toggle .track{ background: #3a3226; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .eye-toggle .knob{ left: 18px; }

  /* app shell */
  .app{
    display:flex;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  /* sidebar */
  .sidebar{
    width: 276px; flex-shrink:0; background: var(--panel); border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh; align-self:flex-start; overflow:hidden;
  }
  .sb-top{ padding:16px 14px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); flex-shrink:0; }
  .brand{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:0 6px 12px; }
  .brand .name{ font-weight:800; font-size:1.05rem; letter-spacing:.02em; line-height:1.1; }
  .brand-sub{ padding:0; margin:0; border:0; display:block; color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.78rem; }
  .brand-sub .name-inline{ padding:0; }
  .editable-inline{
    border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-faint);
    font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: .02em;
    padding: 3px 4px; border-radius: 4px; outline: none;
  }
  .editable-inline:hover{ background: var(--panel-2); }
  .editable-inline:focus{ background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line); }
  .name-inline{ width: 100%; font-weight:700; }
  .cust-lock{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; color:var(--ink);
    padding:10px 12px; border-radius:12px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2);
  }
  .cust-lock:hover{ border-color:var(--ink-faint); }
  .cust-lock .cl-ic{ font-size:20px; width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:10px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:#fdecc8; flex-shrink:0; }
  .cust-lock .cl-tx{ flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1.25; }
  .cust-lock .cl-tx b{ font-size:.82rem; }
  .cust-lock .cl-tx small{ font-size:.72rem; color:var(--ink-dim); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
  .cust-lock .cl-act{ font-size:.72rem; font-weight:800; color:var(--red); }
  .cust-lock.on{ border-color:#7cc99a; }
  .cust-lock.on .cl-ic{ background:#d6f2e1; }
  .sb-nav{ flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:6px 10px 10px; }
  .nav-label{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-dim); padding:10px 12px; margin:3px 0; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; user-select:none; }
  .nav-label:hover{ background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); }
  .nav-label .chev{ font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-faint); transition:transform .15s; }
  .nav-acc.open > .nav-label{ color:var(--ink); }
  .nav-acc.open > .nav-label .chev{ transform:rotate(180deg); }
  .nav-accbody{ display:none; padding:0 0 4px 6px; border-left:2px solid var(--line); margin:0 0 6px 14px; }
  .nav-acc.open > .nav-accbody{ display:block; }
  .nav-accbody .nav-item.active::before{ left:-8px; }
  .nav-item{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:8px 12px; margin:1px 0; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer;
    color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; font-size:.9rem; position:relative; line-height:1.2;
  }
  .nav-item:hover{ background: var(--panel-2); }
  .nav-item.active{ background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 11%, transparent); color:var(--red-dark); font-weight:800; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .nav-item.active{ color:#ffb3b3; }
  .nav-item.active::before{ content:""; position:absolute; left:-10px; top:8px; bottom:8px; width:4px; border-radius:0 4px 4px 0; background:var(--red); }
  .nav-item .ic{ font-size:16px; width:22px; text-align:center; flex-shrink:0; }
  .nav-item .nb{ margin-left:auto; display:none; min-width:20px; height:20px; padding:0 6px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--red); color:#fff; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:800; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .nav-item .nb.on{ display:flex; }
  .nav-fold > .nav-item .chev{ margin-left:auto; color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:11px; transition:transform .15s; }
  .nav-fold.open > .nav-item .chev{ transform:rotate(180deg); }
  .nav-fold > .nav-item{ color:var(--ink-dim); }
  .nav-sub{ display:none; margin:0 0 4px 21px; padding-left:8px; border-left:2px solid var(--line); }
  .nav-fold.open > .nav-sub{ display:block; }
  .nav-sub .nav-item{ font-size:.85rem; padding:7px 10px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-dim); }
  .nav-sub .nav-item.active{ color:var(--red-dark); }
  .nav-sub .nav-item.active::before{ left:-10px; top:6px; bottom:6px; }
  .sb-foot{ flex-shrink:0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:10px 14px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel); }
  .sb-foot .av{ width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--red); color:#fff; font-weight:800; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; }
  .sb-foot .who{ flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1.2; }
  .sb-foot .who b{ font-size:.85rem; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
  .sb-foot .who small{ font-size:.72rem; color:var(--ink-faint); }
  .sb-foot button{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); border-radius:9px; height:34px; padding:0 12px; cursor:pointer; font-size:.8rem; font-weight:700; font-family:inherit; }
  .sb-foot button:hover{ background:var(--sidebar-active); }
  /* müşteri ekranı şifre kapısı */
  #custGate{ position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:1500; display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:20px; background:var(--bg); }
  #custGate.show{ display:flex; }
  #custGate .cg-box{ width:100%; max-width:360px; text-align:center; background:var(--panel); color:var(--ink); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:20px; padding:26px 22px; box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.14); }
  #custGate .cg-logo{ width:min(190px,60vw); margin:0 auto 12px; }
  #custGate .cg-logo svg{ width:100%; height:auto; display:block; }
  #custGate h2{ margin:4px 0 4px; font-size:1.15rem; }
  #custGate p{ margin:0 0 14px; font-size:.85rem; color:var(--ink-dim); }
  #custGate input{ width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; text-align:center; letter-spacing:.12em; font-size:1.15rem; padding:13px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); font-family:inherit; }
  #custGate button.go{ width:100%; margin-top:10px; padding:13px; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:var(--red); color:#fff; font-weight:800; font-size:1rem; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
  #custGate .cg-err{ min-height:16px; margin-top:8px; font-size:.82rem; color:var(--red); }


  /* ciro takibi */
  .ct-bar{ --ct-bar:#cf2e2e; --ct-bar-dim:#e9a3a3; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .ct-bar{ --ct-bar:#ff7a7a; --ct-bar-dim:#7a3b3b; }
  .ct-pills{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin:4px 0 12px; }
  .ct-pill{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); border-radius:999px; padding:7px 13px; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
  .ct-pill:hover{ border-color:var(--ink-faint); }
  .ct-pill.on{ background:var(--red); border-color:var(--red); color:#fff; }
  .ct-range{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:flex-end; gap:12px; }
  .ct-range label{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; font-size:.74rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-dim); }
  .ct-range input[type=date]{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); border-radius:8px; padding:8px 10px; font-family:inherit; font-size:.9rem; }
  .ct-seg{ display:flex; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:9px; overflow:hidden; margin-left:auto; }
  .ct-seg button{ border:0; background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink-dim); padding:9px 14px; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
  .ct-seg button + button{ border-left:1px solid var(--line); }
  .ct-seg button.on{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--panel); }
  .ct-kpis{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr)); gap:12px; margin:14px 0; }
  .ct-kpi{ background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px; padding:14px 16px; }
  .ct-kpi small{ display:block; color:var(--ink-dim); font-size:.76rem; font-weight:700; }
  .ct-kpi b{ display:block; font-size:1.35rem; margin-top:3px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .ct-kpi.main{ grid-column:span 2; border-color:var(--red); }
  .ct-kpi.main b{ font-size:1.9rem; }
  .ct-kpi em{ display:block; font-style:normal; font-size:.76rem; margin-top:3px; color:var(--ink-faint); }
  .ct-kpi em.up{ color:#1f8a4c; } .ct-kpi em.dn{ color:#c0392b; }
  .ct-chart{ position:relative; }
  .ct-chart svg{ width:100%; height:auto; display:block; overflow:visible; }
  .ct-tip{ position:absolute; pointer-events:none; z-index:5; background:var(--ink); color:var(--panel); border-radius:10px; padding:8px 11px; font-size:.78rem; line-height:1.45; white-space:nowrap; display:none; box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
  .ct-tip b{ display:block; margin-bottom:2px; }
  .ct-tablewrap{ overflow-x:auto; max-height:460px; overflow-y:auto; }
  .ct-table{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.86rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .ct-table th, .ct-table td{ padding:9px 12px; text-align:right; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); white-space:nowrap; }
  .ct-table th:first-child, .ct-table td:first-child{ text-align:left; }
  .ct-table thead th{ position:sticky; top:0; background:var(--panel); color:var(--ink-dim); font-size:.74rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; }
  .ct-table tfoot td{ font-weight:800; position:sticky; bottom:0; background:var(--panel-2); }
  .ct-table td.zero{ color:var(--ink-faint); }
  .ct-empty{ padding:28px 10px; text-align:center; color:var(--ink-faint); }

  /* main */
  .main{ flex:1; min-width:0; }
  .topbar{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px;
    padding: 16px 28px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--panel);
  }
  .topbar .title{ font-weight:800; font-size:1.05rem; }
  .topbar .spacer{ flex:1; }
  .topbar .tb-ic{
    width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    background: var(--panel-2); font-size:15px; color: var(--ink-dim);
  }
  .content{ padding: 26px 28px 60px; max-width: 1160px; }

  /* screens */
  .screen{ display:none; }
  .screen.show{ display:block; }

  /* home cards */
  .stat-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap:16px; }
  .stat-card{
    display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:18px;
    background: var(--panel);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    padding: 20px 22px;
  }
  .stat-card .swatch{
    width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:11px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-size:21px; color:#fff; flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .stat-card .info{ flex:1; min-width:0; text-align:right; }
  .stat-card .label{ color: var(--ink-dim); font-size:0.85rem; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .stat-card .value{ font-size:1.6rem; font-weight:800; }
  .stat-card .foot{ color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.78rem; margin-top:10px; padding-top:9px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
  @media (max-width: 900px){ .stat-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
  @media (max-width: 560px){ .stat-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .sw-1{ background: linear-gradient(145deg,var(--card-orange-1),var(--card-orange-2)); }
  .sw-2{ background: linear-gradient(145deg,var(--card-blue-1),var(--card-blue-2)); }
  .sw-3{ background: linear-gradient(145deg,var(--card-green-1),var(--card-green-2)); }
  .sw-4{ background: linear-gradient(145deg,var(--card-pink-1),var(--card-pink-2)); }

  /* settings tabs */
  .settings-card{
    background: var(--panel); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    padding: 24px; margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .settings-head{ display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:16px; margin-bottom:20px; }
  .settings-head .icn{
    width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:10px;
    background: linear-gradient(145deg,var(--card-orange-1),var(--card-orange-2));
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .settings-head h2{ margin:0 0 4px; font-size:1.15rem; }
  .settings-head p{ margin:0; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.85rem; }
  .btn-update{
    margin-left:auto; background: var(--red); color:#fff; border:none;
    padding: 9px 16px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:700; font-size:0.85rem;
    cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .tabs{ display:flex; gap:22px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom:20px; }
  .tab{
    padding-bottom:10px; color: var(--ink-faint); font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem;
    cursor:pointer; border-bottom:2px solid transparent;
  }
  .tab.active{ color: var(--red); border-color: var(--red); }
  .field{ margin-bottom:18px; }
  .field label{ display:block; font-size:0.82rem; color: var(--ink-faint); margin-bottom:6px; }
  .field .val{ font-weight:700; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom:8px; }
  .field-row{ display:flex; gap:24px; }
  .field-row .field{ flex:1; }
  .toggle-row{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:12px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .toggle-row:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
  .mini-toggle{ width:40px;height:22px;border-radius:999px; position:relative; }
  .mini-toggle.on{ background: var(--red); }
  .mini-toggle.off{ background: var(--line); }
  .mini-toggle .k{ position:absolute; top:2px; width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%; background:#fff; }
  .mini-toggle.on .k{ right:2px; }
  .mini-toggle.off .k{ left:2px; }
  .toggle-row .name{ font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; }
  .toggle-row .pay-name{ cursor:text; padding:2px 4px; border-radius:4px; outline:none; }
  .toggle-row .pay-name:hover{ background: var(--panel-2); }
  .toggle-row .pay-name:focus{ background: var(--panel-2); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--red); }
  .toggle-row .pay-edit-hint{ margin-left:6px; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:12px; }

  /* users form */
  .modal-card{
    background: var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding:26px;
    max-width: 620px;
  }
  .modal-card h2{ margin:0 0 4px; }
  .modal-card p.sub{ margin:0 0 22px; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.85rem; }
  .modal-card .field select, .modal-card .field input{
    width:100%; border:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:transparent;
    color: var(--ink); font-family:inherit; font-size:0.95rem; padding:6px 0; font-weight:700;
  }
  .btn-add{
    background: var(--red); color:#fff; border:none; padding:11px 22px; border-radius:8px;
    font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; float:right;
  }

  /* permissions table */
  .perm-table{ background: var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow:hidden; }
  .perm-search{ padding:16px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.85rem; }
  .perm-group-head{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr repeat(5, 70px);
    background: var(--panel-2); font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:800; color: var(--ink-dim);
    padding: 10px 20px;
  }
  .perm-row{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr repeat(5, 70px);
    align-items:center; padding: 14px 20px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); gap: 6px;
  }
  .perm-row .desc b{ display:block; font-size:0.9rem; }
  .perm-row .desc span{ color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.78rem; }
  .chk{ width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:4px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); margin: 0 auto; display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; font-size:12px; color:#fff; }
  .chk.on{ background: var(--red); border-color: var(--red); }

  /* tables / salon grid */
  .table-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px,1fr));
    gap:14px;
  }
  .table-cell{
    background: var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    padding: 18px 12px; text-align:center; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
  }
  .table-cell:hover{ border-color: var(--red); }
  .table-cell .dot{ width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%; margin: 0 auto 8px; }
  .table-cell.empty .dot{ background:#9b948c; }
  .table-cell.busy .dot{ background: var(--red); }
  .table-cell .sum{ font-size:0.72rem; color: var(--ink-faint); font-weight:600; margin-top:4px; }

  /* generic panel used by every new screen */
  .panel-card{ background: var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding:22px 24px; margin-bottom:18px; }
  .panel-head{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin-bottom:16px; }
  .panel-head .pi{ width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:10px; display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:19px;color:#fff; flex-shrink:0; background: linear-gradient(145deg,var(--card-orange-1),var(--card-orange-2)); }
  .panel-head h2{ margin:0 0 2px; font-size:1.05rem; }
  .panel-head p{ margin:0; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.82rem; }
  .panel-head .btn-mini{ margin-left:auto; background: var(--red); color:#fff; border:none; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:700; font-size:0.8rem; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; }

  .plist{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
  .prow{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:12px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
  .prow:last-child{ border-bottom:none; }
  .prow .pic{ font-size:16px; width:22px; text-align:center; color: var(--ink-faint); flex-shrink:0; }
  .prow .pmain{ flex:1; min-width:0; }
  .prow .pmain b{ display:block; font-size:0.92rem; font-weight:700; }
  .prow .pmain span{ color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.78rem; }
  .prow .pval{ font-weight:700; color: var(--ink); font-size:0.9rem; white-space:nowrap; }
  .prow .pval.tag{ background: var(--panel-2); padding:3px 10px; border-radius:999px; font-size:0.76rem; color: var(--ink-dim); font-weight:600; }
  .pcat{ font-weight:800; font-size:0.8rem; color: var(--red); margin: 18px 0 2px; }
  .pcat:first-child{ margin-top:0; }

  .bar-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:9px 0; }
  .bar-row .bname{ width:120px; font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:700; flex-shrink:0; }
  .bar-row .btrack{ flex:1; background: var(--panel-2); height:10px; border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden; }
  .bar-row .bfill{ height:100%; background: var(--red); border-radius:6px; }
  .bar-row .bval{ width:64px; text-align:right; font-size:0.82rem; color: var(--ink-dim); flex-shrink:0; }

  .tile-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:14px; }
  .tile{ background: var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding:18px 20px; }
  .tile .t-label{ color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.8rem; margin-bottom:6px; }
  .tile .t-value{ font-size:1.35rem; font-weight:800; }

  .order-type-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap:14px; }
  .order-type-card{ background: var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding:26px 16px; text-align:center; cursor:pointer; border:2px solid transparent; }
  .order-type-card:hover{ border-color: var(--red); }
  .order-type-card .oi{ font-size:26px; margin-bottom:10px; }
  .order-type-card b{ font-size:0.9rem; }

  .qr-box{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:22px; }
  .qr-square{ width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:10px; background: var(--panel-2); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:38px; flex-shrink:0; }
  .qr-box p{ margin:0; color: var(--ink-dim); font-size:0.88rem; max-width:32ch; }

  /* order ticket */
  .ticket-screen .tb-dark{
    background:#1b1b1b; color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px;
    padding:14px 20px; border-radius:10px 10px 0 0; font-weight:700;
  }
  .ticket-screen .tb-dark .spacer{ flex:1; }
  .order-card{ background: var(--panel); box-shadow: var(--shadow); border-radius:0 0 10px 10px; padding:22px; }
  .order-meta{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color: var(--ink-dim); font-size:0.85rem; margin-bottom:18px; }
  .order-meta b{ color: #4f9130; }
  .order-line{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
  .order-line .qty{ font-weight:800; font-size:1.1rem; width:24px; text-align:center; color: var(--red); }
  .order-line .name{ font-weight:700; }
  .order-line .sub{ color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.8rem; }
  .order-line .price{ margin-left:auto; font-weight:700; color: var(--red); }
  .order-total{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding-top:18px; margin-top:6px; font-weight:800; font-size:1.1rem; }
  .btn-save{ margin-top:18px; width:100%; background: var(--red); color:#fff; border:none; padding:13px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; }
  .order-empty{ display:none; text-align:center; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.88rem; padding:22px 0; }
  .order-empty.show{ display:block; }
  .order-add-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding-top:14px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); margin-top:8px; }
  .order-add-row .btn-mini{ }
  .menu-picker{ margin-top:12px; background: var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:14px; }
  .mp-tabs{ display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:12px; }
  .mp-tab{ padding:6px 13px; border-radius:999px; font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:700; color: var(--ink-dim); background: var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); cursor:pointer; }
  .mp-tab.active{ background: var(--red); color:#fff; border-color: var(--red); }
  .mp-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px,1fr)); gap:10px; }
  .mp-chip{ background: var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:10px 12px; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; }
  .mp-chip:hover{ border-color: var(--red); }
  .mp-chip b{ display:block; font-size:0.84rem; margin-bottom:3px; }
  .mp-chip span{ color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.78rem; }
  .btn-pay{ margin-top:12px; width:100%; background: var(--sage); color:#fff; border:none; padding:13px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; }
  .payment-panel{ margin-top:12px; background: var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:16px; }
  .pp-title{ font-weight:700; font-size:0.86rem; margin-bottom:12px; color: var(--ink-dim); }
  .pp-title b{ color: var(--ink); }
  .pp-methods{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; }
  .pp-method{ flex:1 1 45%; padding:13px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.88rem; color: var(--ink); }
  .pp-method:hover{ border-color: var(--sage); color: var(--sage); }
  .pp-split-row{ margin-bottom:14px; padding-bottom:14px; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line); }
  .pp-split-row label{ display:block; font-size:0.78rem; color: var(--ink-faint); margin-bottom:6px; }
  .pp-split-controls{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
  .pp-split-controls input{
    width:56px; border:1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius:6px;
    padding:8px 8px; font-family:inherit; font-size:0.88rem; font-weight:700; color: var(--ink); text-align:center;
  }
  .pp-split-controls input:focus{ outline:none; border-color: var(--sage); }
  .pp-split-controls span{ font-size:0.82rem; color: var(--ink-dim); }
  .pp-split-controls .link-btn{ margin-left:auto; font-size:0.82rem; }
  .pp-summary{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .pp-row{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:0.86rem; color: var(--ink-dim); }
  .pp-row b{ color: var(--ink); font-weight:700; }
  .pp-row.pp-remaining{ padding-top:8px; border-top:1px dashed var(--line); font-size:0.95rem; }
  .pp-row.pp-remaining b{ color: var(--red); font-weight:800; }
  .pp-amount-row{ margin-bottom:14px; }
  .pp-amount-row label{ display:block; font-size:0.78rem; color: var(--ink-faint); margin-bottom:5px; }
  .pp-amount-row input{
    width:100%; border:1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius:8px;
    padding:11px 12px; font-family:inherit; font-size:0.98rem; font-weight:700; color: var(--ink);
  }
  .pp-amount-row input:focus{ outline:none; border-color: var(--sage); }
  .pp-history{ margin-top:12px; }
  .pp-hist-item{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:0.8rem; color: var(--ink-faint); padding:6px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
  .pp-hist-item:first-child{ border-top:none; }
  .order-line .qty-input{
    width:28px; text-align:center; font-weight:800; font-size:1.1rem; color: var(--red);
    border:none; background:transparent; font-family:inherit; -moz-appearance:textfield;
  }
  .order-line .qty-input:disabled{ opacity:1; -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--red); }
  .order-line .qty-input:not(:disabled){ border-bottom:1px solid var(--red); cursor:text; }
  .order-line .qty-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button, .order-line .qty-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button{ margin-left:4px; }

  .stat-card .foot[data-screen]{ cursor:pointer; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset:2px; }
  .stat-card .foot[data-screen]:hover{ color: var(--red); }

  .mini-toggle{ cursor:pointer; }
  .chk{ cursor:pointer; }
  .table-cell, .order-type-card, .tb-ic, .prow, .sub-item, .nav-item{ user-select:none; }

  /* toast feedback */
  .toast{
    position: fixed; left:50%; bottom: 26px; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);
    background: #1b1b1b; color:#fff; padding: 11px 20px; border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight:600; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition: opacity .25s ease, transform .25s ease;
    z-index: 600; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .toast.show{ opacity:1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }

  /* ---- definition-screen header card (icon + title + desc + action) ---- */
  .def-card{ background: var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding:22px 24px; margin-bottom:18px; }
  .def-head{ display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:16px; }
  .def-head .di{
    width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:10px; flex-shrink:0;
    background: linear-gradient(145deg,var(--card-orange-1),var(--card-orange-2));
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;color:#fff;
  }
  .def-head h2{ margin:0 0 6px; font-size:1.1rem; }
  .def-head p{ margin:0; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.85rem; line-height:1.55; }
  .def-head p .hl{ color: var(--red); font-weight:700; }
  .def-head .btn-mini{ margin-left:auto; flex-shrink:0; }

  .link-row{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:22px; margin: 4px 0 2px; }
  .link-btn{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px;
    color: var(--red); font-weight:700; font-size:0.86rem; cursor:pointer; background:none; border:none; font-family:inherit; padding:0;
  }
  .link-btn:hover{ opacity:0.8; }
  .link-btn.muted{ color: var(--ink-dim); }

  .info-box{
    background: rgba(193,68,44,0.07); border:1px solid rgba(193,68,44,0.18); border-radius:10px;
    padding:16px 18px; color: var(--red); font-size:0.85rem; line-height:1.7; margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  [data-theme="dark"] .info-box{ background: rgba(193,68,44,0.12); }

  /* generic definition table (Mutfak Grupları, Müşteriler) */
  .def-table{ background: var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow:hidden; }
  .def-table .dt-head{ display:flex; gap:14px; padding:12px 20px; background: var(--panel-2); font-size:0.76rem; font-weight:800; color: var(--ink-dim); }
  .def-table .dt-row{ display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:center; padding:14px 20px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); font-size:0.88rem; }
  .def-table .dt-col{ flex:1; min-width:0; }
  .def-table .dt-sort{ cursor:pointer; color: var(--red); user-select:none; }
  .def-table .dt-actions{ display:flex; gap:14px; flex-shrink:0; }
  .def-table .dt-actions .link-btn{ font-size:0.82rem; }
  .badge{ display:inline-block; background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink-dim); font-size:0.76rem; font-weight:700; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:999px; }

  /* category + product screen */
  .cat-layout{ display:flex; gap:0; background: var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); overflow:hidden; min-height: 420px; }
  .cat-sidebar{ width: 210px; flex-shrink:0; border-right:1px solid var(--line); }
  .cat-add{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:16px 18px; color: var(--red); font-weight:700; font-size:0.88rem; cursor:pointer; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
  .cat-item{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:13px 18px; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; position:relative; }
  .cat-item:hover{ background: var(--panel-2); }
  .cat-item.active{ background: var(--sidebar-active); }
  .cat-item .kebab{ margin-left:auto; color: var(--ink-faint); padding:2px 4px; }
  .cat-menu{
    position:absolute; z-index:50; left: 100%; top:0; margin-left:4px;
    background: var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
    min-width:190px; padding:6px 0; display:none;
  }
  .cat-menu.show{ display:block; }
  .cat-menu .cm-item{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:10px 16px; font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:600; color: var(--ink); cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; }
  .cat-menu .cm-item:hover{ background: var(--panel-2); }
  .cat-menu .cm-item.danger{ color: var(--red); }
  .cat-content{ flex:1; min-width:0; padding: 18px 22px 22px; }
  .cat-content-top{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin-bottom:16px; }
  .cat-content-top .link-btn{ margin-left:auto; }
  .cat-search-input{ border:none; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:transparent; color:var(--ink); font-family:inherit; font-size:0.85rem; padding:4px 2px; width:150px; display:none; }
  .cat-search-input.show{ display:inline-block; }
  .product-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(130px,1fr)); gap:14px; }
  .product-card{ background: var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:14px; }
  .product-card .pc-top{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:15px; margin-bottom:10px; }
  .product-card .pc-name{ font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:2px; }
  .product-card .pc-portion{ color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.78rem; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .product-card .pc-price{ font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; }
  .ico{ font-size:1.15em; line-height:1; margin-right:6px; }
  .product-card .pc-ico{ font-size:1.7rem; line-height:1; margin-bottom:6px; }
  .mp-card .mi{ font-size:1.5rem; line-height:1; }
  .c-item .ci{ font-size:2rem; width:56px; text-align:center; flex:none; margin-right:10px; }

  /* masa/bölgeler region tabs + white table cards */
  .region-tabs{ display:flex; gap:26px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); margin: 18px 0 18px; }
  .region-tab{ padding-bottom:10px; color: var(--ink-faint); font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; cursor:pointer; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; }
  .region-tab.active{ color: var(--red); border-color: var(--red); }
  .plain-table-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px,1fr)); gap:14px; }
  .plain-table-cell{
    position:relative; background: var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px;
    min-height:88px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center;
    font-weight:700; font-size:0.92rem; cursor:pointer; padding:10px;
  }
  .plain-table-cell:hover{ border-color: var(--red); }
  .plain-table-cell .pencil{ position:absolute; top:8px; right:10px; color: var(--red); font-size:13px; }
  .plain-table-cell .amt{ display:block; margin-top:6px; font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:600; color: var(--red); }

  /* müşteriler toolbar */
  .cust-toolbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:20px; margin: 16px 0; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .cust-search{ flex:1; min-width:180px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom:8px; color: var(--ink-faint); }
  .cust-search input{ border:none; background:transparent; outline:none; color: var(--ink); font-family:inherit; font-size:0.88rem; flex:1; }
  .cust-filter{ color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.85rem; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
  .pager{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; gap:14px; padding:14px 20px; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:0.85rem; }
  .pager span.pg-arrow{ cursor:pointer; color: var(--red); font-weight:700; }

  /* ---- home charts ---- */
  .chart-card{ background: var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding:20px 22px 8px; margin-top:16px; }
  .chart-row{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:16px; margin-top:16px; }
  @media (max-width: 760px){ .chart-row{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .chart-title{ font-weight:800; font-size:0.95rem; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .chart-card svg text{ fill: var(--ink-faint); font-family:'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; }
  .chart-card svg .grid-line{ stroke: var(--line); stroke-width:1; }
  .chart-card svg .axis-line{ stroke: var(--ink-faint); stroke-width:1; }

  .donut-wrap{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; padding: 10px 0 18px; }
  .donut{ width:200px; height:200px; border-radius:50%; position:relative; }
  .donut .hole{
    position:absolute; inset:34px; border-radius:50%; background: var(--panel);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-weight:800; font-size:1.25rem;
  }
  .donut-legend{ display:flex; gap:22px; margin-top:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; }
  .donut-legend .lg-item{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font-size:0.85rem; color: var(--ink-dim); }
  .donut-legend .lg-dot{ width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; }

  /* ---- Sipariş > Masa operational screen ---- */
  .sm-toolbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:18px; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; }
  .sm-switch{ display:flex; background: var(--panel-2); border-radius:8px; padding:3px; gap:2px; }
  .sm-switch-btn{ padding:9px 16px; border-radius:6px; font-weight:700; font-size:0.85rem; color: var(--ink-dim); cursor:pointer; }
  .sm-switch-btn.active{ background: #1b1b1b; color:#fff; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .sm-switch-btn.active{ background: var(--red); }
  .sm-icons{ display:flex; gap:8px; }
  .sm-ic{
    width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:8px; background: var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:15px; color: var(--ink-dim); cursor:pointer;
  }
  .sm-pill-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px,1fr)); gap:14px; }
  .sm-pill{
    background: var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px;
    padding:16px 18px; font-weight:700; font-size:0.92rem; text-align:center; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .sm-pill:hover{ border-color: var(--red); }
  .sm-pill .amt{ display:block; margin-top:6px; font-size:0.72rem; font-weight:600; color: var(--red); }

  .sm-search{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; background: var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:11px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; max-width:420px; }
  .sm-search input{ border:none; background:transparent; outline:none; color: var(--ink); font-family:inherit; font-size:0.88rem; flex:1; }
  .sm-kanban{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap:16px; }
  @media (max-width: 800px){ .sm-kanban{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .sm-col-head{ padding:10px 16px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:700; font-size:0.85rem; margin-bottom:12px; }
  .sm-col-integ{ background: rgba(224,163,64,0.15); color:#a5651c; }
  .sm-col-prep{ background: rgba(193,68,44,0.12); color: var(--red); }
  .sm-col-wait{ background: rgba(224,163,64,0.15); color:#a5651c; }
  .sm-order-card{ background: var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:12px; cursor:pointer; }
  .sm-order-card:hover{ border-color: var(--red); }
  .sm-order-card .oc-top{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; }
  .sm-order-card .oc-avatar{ width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%; background: var(--amber); display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; font-size:14px; flex-shrink:0; }
  .sm-order-card .oc-name{ font-weight:700; font-size:0.9rem; }
  .sm-order-card .oc-timer{ font-size:0.75rem; color: var(--ink-faint); }
  .sm-order-card .oc-no{ margin-left:auto; font-size:0.8rem; color: var(--ink-faint); }
  .sm-order-card .oc-total{ text-align:right; font-weight:800; margin:10px 0 8px; }
  .sm-order-card .oc-actions{ display:flex; gap:14px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding-top:10px; color: var(--ink-faint); font-size:14px; }

  .qty-ctl{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; flex-shrink:0; }
  .qty-ctl .qv{ min-width:26px; text-align:center; font-size:1.05rem; color: var(--red); }
  .qbtn{ width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel-2); color: var(--ink); font-size:18px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; line-height:1; }
  .qbtn:hover{ border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); }
  .del-btn{ border:none; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; font-size:16px; opacity:.55; padding:6px; }
  .del-btn:hover{ opacity:1; }

  body:not(.staff) .app, body:not(.staff) .eye-toggle, body:not(.staff) .staff-bar{ display:none !important; }
  body.staff #customerView{ display:none; }
  #customerView{ min-height:100vh; max-width:760px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 16px 120px; }
  .c-head{ text-align:center; padding:26px 0 14px; }
  .c-head .logo{ width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:13px; background:var(--red); color:#fff; font-weight:800; font-size:24px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .c-head h1{ margin:10px 0 2px; font-size:1.35rem; } .c-head p{ margin:0; color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.85rem; }
  .c-masa{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; background:var(--panel); border-radius:12px; padding:12px 16px; box-shadow:var(--shadow); margin-bottom:14px; font-weight:700; }
  .c-masa select{ flex:1; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); border-radius:8px; padding:9px; font-family:inherit; font-weight:700; }
  .c-tabs{ display:flex; gap:8px; overflow-x:auto; padding-bottom:8px; position:sticky; top:0; background:var(--bg); z-index:5; padding-top:6px; }
  .c-tab{ white-space:nowrap; padding:8px 15px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); font-weight:700; font-size:.85rem; cursor:pointer; }
  .c-tab.active{ background:var(--red); color:#fff; border-color:var(--red); }
  .c-item{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; background:var(--panel); border-radius:12px; box-shadow:var(--shadow); padding:14px 16px; margin-top:10px; }
  .c-item .nm{ flex:1; } .c-item .nm b{ display:block; } .c-item .nm span{ color:var(--red); font-weight:800; font-size:.9rem; }
  .c-bar{ position:fixed; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; background:var(--panel); border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding:12px 16px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); box-shadow:0 -4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.08); z-index:20; }
  .c-bar-in{ max-width:760px; margin:0 auto; }
  .c-send{ width:100%; border:none; background:var(--red); color:#fff; padding:14px; border-radius:10px; font-weight:800; font-size:1rem; cursor:pointer; }
  .c-send:disabled{ opacity:.5; }
  .c-note{ width:100%; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); border-radius:8px; padding:9px; font-family:inherit; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .c-status{ background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:11px 14px; margin-bottom:8px; font-weight:700; font-size:.88rem; }
  .c-staff-link{ position:fixed; left:12px; bottom:84px; font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-faint); background:transparent; border:none; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:underline; z-index:21; padding:4px; }
  .modal-bg{ display:none; position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,.5); z-index:900; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:16px; }
  .modal-bg.show{ display:flex; }
  .modal-box{ background:var(--panel); color:var(--ink); border-radius:14px; padding:22px; width:100%; max-width:440px; max-height:86vh; overflow:auto; }
  .modal-box input{ width:100%; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); border-radius:8px; padding:12px; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; margin:12px 0; }
  .staff-bar{ position:fixed; right:14px; bottom:14px; display:flex; gap:8px; z-index:600; align-items:center; }
  .staff-bar button{ position:relative; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel); color:var(--ink); border-radius:999px; padding:10px 14px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:var(--shadow); font-family:inherit; }
  .staff-bar .badge-n{ position:absolute; top:-6px; right:-6px; background:var(--red); color:#fff; border-radius:999px; min-width:20px; height:20px; font-size:11px; display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .staff-bar .badge-n.on{ display:flex; }
  .staff-bar .mode{ font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-faint); background:var(--panel); padding:6px 10px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--line); }
  .co-card, .k-card{ background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:14px; margin-bottom:10px; }
  .co-card .acts, .k-card .acts{ display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:10px; }
  .co-card .acts button, .k-card .acts button{ flex:1; padding:10px; border:none; border-radius:8px; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; color:#fff; }
  .b-ok{ background:var(--sage); } .b-no{ background:var(--red); }
  .k-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr)); gap:12px; }
  .k-card.hazir{ border-color:var(--sage); } .k-card .tag{ font-size:.72rem; background:var(--panel); padding:2px 8px; border-radius:999px; color:var(--ink-dim); }

  @media print{
    body *{ visibility:hidden; }
    .ticket-screen, .ticket-screen *{ visibility:visible; }
    .ticket-screen{ position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; }
    .order-add-row, .menu-picker, .btn-save, .btn-pay, .payment-panel, .del-btn, .qbtn{ display:none !important; }
  }
.sm-kanban{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr !important;} .pc-top span{cursor:pointer;} .prow .link-btn{margin-left:10px;}

  .c-logo{ width:210px; max-width:62vw; margin:0 auto; color:var(--ink); --lgbg:var(--panel); user-select:none; -webkit-user-select:none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent; touch-action:manipulation; cursor:default; }
  .c-logo svg, .sb-logo svg{ width:100%; height:auto; display:block; }
  .c-head{ padding-top:22px; } .c-head p{ margin-top:6px !important; }
  .sb-logo{ width:40px; height:40px; color:var(--ink); --lgbg:var(--panel); flex-shrink:0; }
  .ff .ffr{ margin:10px 0; } .ff label{ display:block; font-size:.8rem; color:var(--ink-faint); margin-bottom:4px; font-weight:700; }
  .ff input:not([type=checkbox]), .ff select, .ff textarea{ width:100%; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); border-radius:8px; padding:11px; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; margin:0; }
  .ff .ffc{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:.95rem; color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; margin:6px 0; }
  .ff .ffc input{ width:auto; margin:0; padding:0; }
  .ff .ffchk{ max-height:200px; overflow:auto; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:6px 10px; background:var(--panel-2); }
  .fferr{ color:var(--red); font-size:.85rem; min-height:18px; margin:6px 0; }
  #btnMenu{ display:none; cursor:pointer; }
  #printArea{ display:none; }
  .order-line .link-btn.nt{ display:inline-block; margin-top:4px; font-size:.78rem; }
  @media (max-width: 860px){
    #btnMenu{ display:flex; }
    .sidebar{ position:fixed !important; top:0; bottom:0; height:auto !important; left:0; z-index:700; transform:translateX(-105%); transition:transform .2s; max-width:84vw; }
    .sidebar.open{ transform:none; box-shadow:6px 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35); }
    .content{ padding:18px 14px 90px !important; } .topbar{ padding:12px 14px !important; }
    .eye-toggle .track, #eyeLabel{ display:none; }
    .perm-group-head, .perm-row{ overflow-x:auto; }
    .def-table{ overflow-x:auto; } .def-table .dt-head, .def-table .dt-row{ min-width:640px; }
  }
  @media print{
    body.rcpt .app, body.rcpt .staff-bar, body.rcpt .eye-toggle, body.rcpt .toast{ display:none !important; }
    body.rcpt *{ visibility:hidden; }
    body.rcpt #printArea, body.rcpt #printArea *{ visibility:visible !important; }
    body.rcpt #printArea{ display:block !important; position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:72mm; font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace; font-size:12px; color:#000; background:#fff; padding:4mm; }
  }
  [role="button"]:focus-visible, [contenteditable]:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid var(--red); outline-offset:2px; }

  /* ---- tam ekran menü & ödeme ---- */
  #menuPicker,#paymentPanel{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:900;margin:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--bg);overflow:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
  #menuPicker{display:none;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;padding:0}
  .mp-head,.pp-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px;background:var(--panel);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:3;flex:none}
  .mp-head b,.pp-head b{flex:1;font-size:1.05rem}
  .mp-x{border:0;background:var(--panel-2);color:var(--ink);width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer}
  #mpSearch,.c-search{width:100%;padding:11px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);font:inherit;box-sizing:border-box}
  .mp-sw{padding:10px 16px 0;flex:none}
  #menuPicker .mp-tabs{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;padding:10px 16px;margin:0;flex:none}
  #menuPicker .mp-tab{white-space:nowrap;padding:9px 16px;font-size:.88rem}
  #menuPicker .mp-subs{padding-top:0} #menuPicker .mp-subs .mp-tab{padding:6px 12px;font-size:.78rem;background:transparent}
  #menuPicker .mp-subs .mp-tab.active{background:var(--red)}
  .c-subs{padding-top:0!important} .c-subs .c-tab{padding:5px 12px!important;font-size:.76rem!important;background:transparent!important;border:1px solid var(--line)!important} .c-subs .c-tab.active{background:var(--red)!important;color:#fff;border-color:var(--red)!important}
  .c-subttl{font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--red);margin:14px 2px 4px}
  #menuPicker .mp-grid{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:4px 16px 16px;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));align-content:start}
  .mp-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);min-height:100px;cursor:pointer}
  .mp-card.in{border-color:var(--red)} .mp-card b{font-size:.92rem} .mp-card .pr{color:var(--red);font-weight:800}
  .mp-card .ctl{margin-top:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px}
  .mp-card .ctl button{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel-2);color:var(--ink);font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
  .mp-card .ctl button.pl{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red)} .mp-card .ctl .q{font-weight:800}
  .mp-foot{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 16px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:var(--panel);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  .mp-foot span{flex:1;font-weight:800} .mp-foot .btn-save{margin:0;width:auto;padding:13px 22px}
  #paymentPanel .pp-body{max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px}
  .pp-sum-card{background:var(--panel);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:14px}
  #paymentPanel .pp-row{font-size:1rem} #paymentPanel .pp-row.pp-remaining{font-size:1.35rem}
  #paymentPanel .pp-method{flex:1 1 44%;padding:18px 10px;font-size:1rem;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
  #paymentPanel .pp-amount-row input{font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:800;text-align:center}
  /* ---- müşteri arayüzü ---- */
  .c-top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:6;background:var(--bg);padding-bottom:4px} .c-top .c-tabs{position:static;padding-top:10px} .c-top .c-masa{margin-bottom:10px}
  .c-item{padding:12px 14px} .c-item .nm b{font-size:1rem}
  .c-item .qbtn{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel-2);font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
  .c-item .qbtn[data-d="1"]{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red)}
  .c-item .qty-ctl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .c-bar-in{max-height:75vh;overflow:auto;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}
  .c-crow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600}
  .c-crow .qbtn{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel-2);color:var(--ink);font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:800}
  .c-crow .qty-ctl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  #customerView.menu-only .c-bar,#customerView.menu-only .c-masa,#customerView.menu-only .qbtn,#customerView.menu-only .qty-ctl{display:none!important}
  /* ---- müşteri girişi: sade, göz yormayan ---- */
  #customerView .c-head{padding:16px 0 4px;display:flex;justify-content:center}
  #customerView .c-head .c-logo{width:84px;max-width:28vw;margin:0 auto;opacity:.92}
  #customerView .c-masa{display:none}
  #customerView .c-search{background:var(--panel-2);border-color:transparent}
  #customerView .c-tab{padding:7px 14px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600}
  #customerView .c-item{box-shadow:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;margin-top:8px}
  #customerView .c-item .nm span{color:var(--ink-dim);font-weight:700}
  .c-tgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin:12px 0;max-height:52vh;overflow:auto}
  .c-tgrid button{padding:14px 4px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel-2);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;cursor:pointer}
  .c-tgrid button:active{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
  /* ---- müşteri: yumuşak gökkuşağı geçişli zemin ---- */
  body:not(.staff){background:linear-gradient(125deg,#ffe3ec,#ffeedd,#fff9d6,#e4f8e6,#e0f2ff,#ece4ff,#ffe3ec);background-size:300% 300%;background-attachment:fixed;animation:rbFlow 40s ease-in-out infinite}
  body[data-theme="dark"]:not(.staff){background:linear-gradient(125deg,#2b1e2c,#2c2520,#2b2b1d,#1e2b23,#1c2731,#261f34,#2b1e2c);background-size:300% 300%;background-attachment:fixed}
  @keyframes rbFlow{0%{background-position:0% 50%}50%{background-position:100% 50%}100%{background-position:0% 50%}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ body:not(.staff){animation:none} }
  #customerView .c-head{padding:18px 0 6px}
  #customerView .c-head .c-logo{width:128px;max-width:42vw;opacity:1;--lgbg:rgba(255,255,255,.85)}
  body[data-theme="dark"] #customerView .c-head .c-logo{--lgbg:rgba(30,26,34,.9)}
  #customerView .c-top{background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);margin:0 -16px;padding:6px 16px 4px;border-radius:0 0 18px 18px}
  #customerView .c-item{background:rgba(255,255,255,.62);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
  #customerView .c-tab{background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);border-color:transparent}
  #customerView .c-tab.active{background:var(--red);color:#fff}
  #customerView .c-search{background:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
  #customerView .c-bar{background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
  body[data-theme="dark"] #customerView .c-top{background:rgba(20,18,24,.4)}
  body[data-theme="dark"] #customerView .c-item{background:rgba(34,30,38,.62);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
  body[data-theme="dark"] #customerView .c-tab,body[data-theme="dark"] #customerView .c-search{background:rgba(40,36,46,.7)}
  body[data-theme="dark"] #customerView .c-bar{background:rgba(26,23,30,.82)}
  /* ---- canlı 3D logo ---- */
  .c-logo,.sb-logo{perspective:420px}
  .c-logo svg,.sb-logo svg{overflow:visible;transform-style:preserve-3d;animation:lgFloat 6s ease-in-out infinite;will-change:transform}

  /* ---- sadece-menü anahtarı (Menü / Ürünler altı) ---- */
  .mo-card{margin-top:16px;background:var(--panel);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:16px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
  .mo-card .mo-txt{flex:1;min-width:0} .mo-card .mo-txt b{display:block;font-size:.98rem} .mo-card .mo-txt span{display:block;color:var(--ink-dim);font-size:.82rem;margin-top:3px}
  .mo-sw{flex:none;width:58px;height:32px;border-radius:999px;border:0;background:#c9c3bb;position:relative;cursor:pointer;padding:0;margin:0}
  .mo-sw::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:transform .18s ease}
  .mo-sw.on{background:var(--red)} .mo-sw.on::after{transform:translateX(26px)}
  /* ---- kayıt onay / hata bannerı ---- */
  #saveBanner{position:fixed;left:50%;top:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));transform:translate(-50%,-140%);z-index:3000;width:min(92vw,520px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:18px 20px;border-radius:16px;background:#1f9d57;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2),opacity .2s ease}
  #saveBanner.show{transform:translate(-50%,0);opacity:1}
  #saveBanner.err{background:#cf2e2e}
  #saveBanner .sb-ic{flex:none;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:800}
  #saveBanner .sb-t{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1.25} #saveBanner .sb-s{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;opacity:.92;margin-top:2px}
  /* personel menü seçici: ürün görseli / açıklama */
  .mp-card .mp-img{width:100%;height:84px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover}
  .mp-card small{color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.74rem;line-height:1.25}
  .mp-foot .btn-save.mp-save{background:#1f9d57}
  .mp-foot .btn-save.mp-back{background:var(--ink-faint)}


  /* ---- müşteri başlık: yan yana premium logo + sosyal medya ---- */
  #customerView .c-head{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:16px 0 6px}
  #customerView .c-head .c-logo{width:min(380px,94vw);max-width:94vw;opacity:1}
  .c-logo svg{animation-name:lgFloat2}
  @keyframes lgFloat2{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotateY(-5deg) rotateX(2deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-3px) rotateY(5deg) rotateX(-1deg)}}
  .c-social{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;margin-top:2px}
  .c-social a,.c-social button{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid var(--soc-bd,rgba(233,196,106,.55));background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--soc-b1,#2d1a10),var(--soc-b2,#150a05));color:var(--soc-ic,#f4d27a);box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.15);cursor:pointer;padding:0;text-decoration:none;transition:transform .15s}
  .c-social a:active,.c-social button:active{transform:scale(.92)} .c-social svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
  .c-social .fl{fill:currentColor;stroke:none}
  @keyframes lgFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotateY(-11deg) rotateX(4deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-4px) rotateY(11deg) rotateX(-2deg)}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.c-logo svg,.sb-logo svg{animation:none}}
  /* ---- marka logosu: yan yana, kalp atışı ---- */
  .c-logo svg{filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(120,10,10,.22))}
  @keyframes lgFloat2{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-2px)}}
  .lg-hb{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:lgBeat 2.8s ease-in-out infinite}
  @keyframes lgBeat{0%,38%,100%{transform:scale(1)}10%{transform:scale(1.16)}20%{transform:scale(1)}28%{transform:scale(1.1)}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.lg-hb{animation:none}}
  .lg-ring{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;opacity:0;animation:lgRing 2.8s ease-out infinite}
  @keyframes lgRing{0%{opacity:.45;transform:scale(.7)}24%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.6)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.6)}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.lg-ring{animation:none}}
  body[data-theme="dark"] .c-logo svg{filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 10px rgba(255,40,24,.28))}
  /* ---- hafif zemin: kasma yok ---- */
  body:not(.staff){background:#fbeef2!important;animation:none!important;background-attachment:scroll!important}
  body:not(.staff)::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:-40%;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#ffe3ec,#ffeedd,#fff9d6,#e4f8e6,#e0f2ff,#ece4ff,#ffe3ec);animation:bgSpin 120s linear infinite;will-change:transform}
  body[data-theme="dark"]:not(.staff){background:#1a1620!important}
  body[data-theme="dark"]:not(.staff)::before{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#2b1e2c,#2c2520,#2b2b1d,#1e2b23,#1c2731,#261f34,#2b1e2c)}
  @keyframes bgSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){body:not(.staff)::before{animation:none}}
  #customerView .c-top,#customerView .c-item,#customerView .c-bar,#customerView .c-tab,#customerView .c-search{-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important;backdrop-filter:none!important}
  #customerView .c-item{background:rgba(255,255,255,.82)}
  #customerView .c-top{background:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
  #customerView .c-bar{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92)}
  body[data-theme="dark"] #customerView .c-item{background:rgba(36,31,42,.86)}
  body[data-theme="dark"] #customerView .c-top{background:rgba(24,20,30,.7)}
  body[data-theme="dark"] #customerView .c-bar{background:rgba(26,23,30,.94)}
  .c-logo svg{filter:none!important;animation:none!important}

  /* ===== v2: üst sağ aksiyonlar ===== */
  .top-actions{ position:fixed; top:14px; right:14px; z-index:600; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
  .top-actions .eye-toggle{ position:static; }
  .top-actions .staff-bar{ position:static; display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; }
  .staff-bar .ta-btn{ width:38px; height:38px; padding:0; border-radius:50%; font-size:17px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .staff-bar .ta-btn:hover{ border-color:var(--red); }
  .staff-bar .mode{ max-width:190px; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
  body:not(.staff) .top-actions{ display:none !important; }
  .topbar{ padding-right:300px; }
  @media (max-width:1100px){ .staff-bar .mode{ display:none; } .topbar{ padding-right:190px; } }
  @media (max-width:860px){ .topbar{ padding-right:14px !important; } .top-actions{ top:8px; right:8px; gap:6px; } .top-actions .eye-toggle{ padding:6px 9px; } }

  /* ===== v2: masa adı kalemi ===== */
  .pen-btn{ cursor:pointer; margin-left:8px; font-size:.95em; opacity:.8; user-select:none; }
  .pen-btn:hover{ opacity:1; }
  .bn{ display:block; font-size:.68rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-faint); margin-top:2px; }
  .gname{ color:var(--red); }

  /* ===== v2: menü seçici (müşteri tarzı sepet) ===== */
  .mp-head .mp-x.wide{ width:auto; padding:0 12px; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:700; border-radius:19px; }
  .mp-card .mp-ex{ font-size:.7rem; color:var(--ink-faint); font-weight:700; }
  .mp-foot .mp-pay{ background:var(--sage); }
  .mp-foot .mp-pay[disabled]{ opacity:.45; }
  #mpCart{ position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:6; background:var(--bg); display:none; flex-direction:column; }
  #mpCart.show{ display:flex; }
  #mpCart .mc-body{ flex:1; overflow:auto; padding:12px 16px; max-width:640px; width:100%; margin:0 auto; }
  #mpCart h4{ margin:16px 0 6px; font-size:.78rem; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--red); }
  #mpCart .c-crow small{ display:block; color:var(--ink-faint); font-weight:600; }
  #mpCart .c-crow.ro{ font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-dim); }
  #mpCart .mp-empty{ color:var(--ink-faint); padding:8px 0; margin:0; }
  #mpCart .mc-foot{ flex:none; padding:12px 16px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)); background:var(--panel); border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
  #mpCart .mc-foot-in{ max-width:640px; margin:0 auto; }
  #mpCart .mc-tot{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-weight:800; margin-bottom:8px; }
  #mpCart .btn-save{ margin:0; width:100%; }
  #mpCart .btn-save[disabled]{ opacity:.5; }

  /* ===== v2: ürün seçip taşıma ===== */
  .order-line .mv-ck{ width:22px; height:22px; flex:none; margin-right:6px; accent-color:var(--red); }
  .mv-hint{ font-size:.76rem; color:var(--ink-faint); margin:2px 2px 8px; }
  .mv-region{ font-weight:800; font-size:.78rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; color:var(--ink-faint); margin:12px 0 6px; }
  .mv-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(96px,1fr)); gap:8px; }
  .mv-grid button{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); border-radius:10px; padding:10px 6px; font:inherit; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; }
  .mv-grid button small{ display:block; font-size:.7rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--sage); margin-top:3px; }
  .mv-grid button.busy{ border-color:var(--red); } .mv-grid button.busy small{ color:var(--red); }
  .mv-grid button:disabled{ opacity:.35; cursor:not-allowed; }

  /* ===== v2: Menü / Ürünler düzeni ===== */
  .cat-sidebar{ width:250px; background:var(--panel-2); }
  .cat-grp{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:14px 18px 6px; font-size:.72rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-faint); }
  .cat-grp .n{ margin-left:auto; font-weight:700; }
  .cat-item.sub{ padding:9px 18px 9px 34px; font-size:.86rem; font-weight:600; }
  .cat-item.solo{ padding:12px 18px; font-weight:700; }
  .cat-item .cnt{ margin-left:auto; font-size:.72rem; color:var(--ink-faint); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:999px; padding:1px 8px; font-weight:700; }
  .cat-item .cnt + .kebab{ margin-left:6px; }
  .cat-item.active{ background:var(--panel); box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--red); }
  .cat-content-top{ flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .cat-title{ flex:1; min-width:160px; } .cat-title b{ display:block; font-size:1.05rem; } .cat-title span{ color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.8rem; }
  .cat-content-top .cat-search-input{ display:inline-block; width:170px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:8px 10px; background:var(--panel-2); }
  .cat-content-top .link-btn.add{ margin-left:0; background:var(--red); color:#fff; padding:9px 14px; border-radius:8px; font-weight:700; }
  .product-list{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; }
  .prow2{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:10px 14px; background:var(--panel); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
  .prow2:last-child{ border-bottom:0; } .prow2:hover{ background:var(--panel-2); }
  .prow2 .pi2{ display:none; }
  .prow2 .pn{ flex:1; min-width:0; } .prow2 .pn b{ display:block; font-size:.92rem; } .prow2 .pn span{ font-size:.76rem; color:var(--ink-faint); }
  .prow2 .pp{ font-weight:800; white-space:nowrap; }
  .prow2 .pa{ display:flex; gap:4px; } .prow2 .pa button{ border:0; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; font-size:15px; padding:6px 8px; border-radius:6px; color:var(--ink-dim); } .prow2 .pa button:hover{ background:var(--panel-2); }
  .prod-empty{ padding:26px; text-align:center; color:var(--ink-faint); }
  @media (max-width:860px){
    .cat-layout{ flex-direction:column; } .cat-sidebar{ width:auto; max-height:230px; overflow:auto; border-right:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
    .cat-menu{ left:auto; right:8px; top:100%; margin-left:0; }
  }

  /* ===== v3: görselli kategori & ürün kutucukları ===== */
  .vis{ position:relative; overflow:hidden; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:linear-gradient(135deg,hsl(var(--h,20),90%,91%),hsl(calc(var(--h,20) + 40),85%,82%)); }
  body[data-theme="dark"] .vis{ background:linear-gradient(135deg,hsl(var(--h,20),32%,26%),hsl(calc(var(--h,20) + 40),34%,18%)); }
  .vis .vi{ font-size:var(--fs,2.4rem); line-height:1; filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.18)); }
  .vis img{ position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; }
  .c-sk{ pointer-events:none; } .c-sk .vis{ animation:skPulse 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; } .c-sk .nm b{ display:block; height:14px; margin:8px 0; border-radius:6px; background:var(--line); }
  @keyframes skPulse{ 0%,100%{ opacity:.55 } 50%{ opacity:1 } }
  .vis.v-s{ width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:8px; --fs:1rem; flex:none; margin-right:8px; }
  .vis.v-row{ width:54px; height:54px; border-radius:10px; --fs:1.7rem; flex:none; }
  .vis.v-sub{ width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:10px; --fs:1.05rem; flex:none; }
  #customerView .c-subs .c-tab.c-subv{ display:flex !important; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:4px 13px 4px 4px !important; }
  #customerView .c-subs .c-tab.c-subv:first-child{ padding-left:13px !important; }
  .vis.v-cat{ width:68px; height:68px; border-radius:18px; --fs:2rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
  .vis.v-card{ width:100%; aspect-ratio:4/3; border-radius:12px 12px 0 0; --fs:3.2rem; }
  .vis.v-mp{ width:100%; height:92px; border-radius:9px; --fs:2.6rem; }
  /* kategori şeritleri (müşteri + personel) */
  .c-tabs:has(.c-cat), .mp-tabs:has(.mp-cat){ gap:8px; padding:8px 6px 8px !important; }
  #customerView .c-tab.c-cat, #menuPicker .mp-tab.mp-cat{ background:none !important; border:0 !important; padding:2px 0 !important; border-radius:0 !important; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:5px; flex:none; width:86px; color:var(--ink) !important; font-size:.74rem !important; font-weight:700 !important; }
  .c-cat .lb, .mp-cat .lb{ max-width:82px; white-space:normal; text-align:center; line-height:1.15; }
  .c-cat.active .vis, .mp-cat.active .vis{ outline:3px solid var(--red); outline-offset:2px; }
  .c-cat.active .lb, .mp-cat.active .lb{ color:var(--red); }
  #menuPicker .mp-tab.mp-cat .vis{ width:58px; height:58px; --fs:1.7rem; }
  /* müşteri ürün kartları */
  #cItems{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:12px; }
  @media (min-width:640px){ #cItems{ grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); } }
  #cItems .c-subttl, #cItems > p{ grid-column:1/-1; }
  #customerView .c-item.card{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:stretch; padding:0; margin:0; gap:0; overflow:hidden; }
  .c-item.card .nm{ padding:10px 12px 4px; flex:1; } .c-item.card .nm b{ font-size:.92rem; line-height:1.2; }
  .c-item.card .nm small{ display:block; color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.74rem; line-height:1.25; margin-top:3px; }
  .c-item.card .cfoot{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; padding:6px 12px 12px; }
  .c-item.card .cfoot .pr{ font-weight:800; color:var(--red); }
  .c-item.card .qty-ctl{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
  /* dosya alanı */
  .ffimg{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .ffimg .ffprev{ width:64px; height:64px; border-radius:10px; --fs:1.6rem; flex:none; }
  .ffimg .ffrm{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); border-radius:8px; padding:6px 10px; cursor:pointer; font:inherit; font-size:.8rem; }
  .vis{ flex:none; }
  #menuPicker .mp-grid{ grid-auto-rows:max-content; }
  .mp-card{ min-height:0; }
  .mp-card .vis.v-mp{ min-height:92px; }
  /* mobil: + / adet kontrolü kartın dışına taşmasın */
  .c-item.card .cfoot{ flex-direction:column; align-items:stretch; gap:8px; }
  .c-item.card .cfoot .pr{ text-align:left; }
  .c-item.card .cfoot > .qbtn{ width:100%; }
  .c-item.card .qty-ctl{ width:100%; justify-content:space-between; }
  .c-item.card .qty-ctl .qbtn{ flex:none; }
  #cItems{ padding-bottom:150px; }
  /* + / − kontrolü dar ekranda kırpılmasın (esnek genişlik) */
  .c-item.card .qty-ctl, .mp-card .ctl{ min-width:0; gap:6px; }
  .c-item.card .qty-ctl .qbtn, .c-item.card .cfoot > .qbtn{ flex:1 1 0 !important; min-width:0; width:auto !important; max-width:48px; height:40px; }
  .c-item.card .cfoot > .qbtn{ max-width:none; flex:none !important; width:100% !important; }
  .c-item.card .qty-ctl .qv{ flex:none; min-width:20px; }
  .c-item.card .cfoot{ min-width:0; padding-left:10px; padding-right:10px; }
  .mp-card{ min-width:0; }
  .mp-card .ctl button{ flex:1 1 0; min-width:0; max-width:48px; width:auto !important; }
  .mp-card .ctl button.pl{ flex:0 0 44px; max-width:none; width:44px !important; }
  .mp-card .ctl .q{ flex:none; min-width:18px; text-align:center; }
  #cItems{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
  @media (min-width:640px){ #cItems{ grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); } }
  #menuPicker .mp-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr)); }
  /* arama + kategori şeritleri sayfayla birlikte kaysın; ürünlere tam ekran yer kalsın */
  #customerView .c-top{ position:static !important; }
  #customerView .c-top .c-tabs{ position:static; }
  #menuPicker{ overflow-y:auto !important; display:none; }
  #menuPicker .mp-grid{ flex:none !important; overflow:visible !important; }
  #menuPicker .mp-foot{ position:sticky; bottom:0; z-index:4; margin-top:auto; }
  #mpCart{ position:fixed !important; }
  .vis img{ object-fit:cover; }

  /* ===== v4: Menü / Ürünler — ana kategori › alt kategori düzeni + toplu fiyat ===== */
  #screen-urunler .cat-layout{ overflow:visible; align-items:flex-start; }
  #screen-urunler .cat-sidebar{ width:320px; background:var(--panel-2); border-radius:12px 0 0 12px; border-right:1px solid var(--line); align-self:stretch; }
  #screen-urunler .cat-content{ padding:20px 22px 24px; }
  .sb-top{ padding:14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
  .sb-add{ width:100%; padding:11px 14px !important; font-size:.9rem !important; }
  .sb-hint{ font-size:.74rem; color:var(--ink-faint); line-height:1.45; }
  .sb-hint b{ color:var(--ink-dim); }
  .sb-list{ padding:6px 8px 16px; }
  .sb-label{ font-size:.68rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-faint); padding:14px 10px 4px; }
  .tg-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:7px 8px; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; position:relative; user-select:none; }
  .tg-row:hover{ background:var(--panel); }
  .tg-row.active{ background:var(--panel); box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--red), 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.07); }
  .tg-row .vis{ margin-right:0 !important; }
  .tg-main{ margin-top:4px; padding:8px; }
  .tg-main .tg-name b{ font-size:.93rem; font-weight:800; white-space:normal; }
  .vis.v-tg{ width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:11px; --fs:1.2rem; flex:none; }
  .tg-name{ flex:1; min-width:0; line-height:1.2; }
  .tg-name b{ display:block; font-size:.86rem; font-weight:700; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
  .tg-name small{ display:block; font-size:.7rem; color:var(--ink-faint); font-weight:700; margin-top:2px; }
  .tg-chev{ width:22px; height:22px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:6px; color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.78rem; flex:none; transition:transform .15s ease, background-color .15s ease; }
  .tg-chev:hover{ background:var(--line); }
  .tg-chev.open{ transform:rotate(90deg); }
  .tg-spacer{ width:22px; flex:none; }
  .tg-row .cnt{ font-size:.72rem; color:var(--ink-faint); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:999px; padding:1px 8px; font-weight:700; flex:none; }
  .tg-k{ width:26px; height:26px; display:grid; place-items:center; border-radius:7px; color:var(--ink-faint); font-weight:800; flex:none; }
  .tg-k:hover{ background:var(--line); color:var(--ink); }
  .tg-subs{ margin:2px 0 6px 29px; padding-left:12px; border-left:2px solid var(--line); }
  .tg-sub{ padding:5px 6px; }
  .tg-sub::before{ content:''; position:absolute; left:-14px; top:50%; width:12px; height:2px; background:var(--line); }

  #catPop{ position:fixed; z-index:1200; display:none; min-width:240px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:11px; box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.22); padding:6px; }

  .lvl-main{ background:rgba(207,46,46,.12); color:var(--red); }
  .lvl-sub{ background:rgba(47,143,91,.15); color:var(--sage); }
  .lvl-all{ background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink-dim); border:1px solid var(--line); }
  .mh-crumb{ font-size:.8rem; color:var(--ink-faint); font-weight:700; }
  .mh-txt h2{ margin:6px 0 4px; font-size:1.35rem; line-height:1.15; }

  .mbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:14px 0; }
  .mbar .cat-search-input{ display:inline-block; margin-left:auto; flex:1 1 150px; min-width:140px; max-width:260px; width:auto; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:9px; padding:9px 11px; background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); font:inherit; font-size:.85rem; }
  .seg{ display:inline-flex; background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:11px; padding:3px; gap:2px; }

  #segPrice.on{ background:var(--red); color:#fff; }
  .seg.mini{ align-self:flex-start; } .seg.mini button{ padding:5px 11px; font-size:.78rem; }
  .pt{ display:none; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); border-radius:12px; padding:14px; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .pt.show{ display:block; }
  .pt-head{ display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:6px 12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:10px; }

  .pt-scope{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px 14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:12px; padding:9px 12px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:9px; font-size:.8rem; color:var(--ink-faint); }
  .pt-scope b{ color:var(--ink); font-size:.85rem; }

  .pt-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr)); gap:12px; }
  .pt-card{ background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:12px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:9px; }
  .pt-card h4{ margin:0; font-size:.9rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
  .pt-card h4 i{ font-style:normal; width:22px; height:22px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--red); color:#fff; display:grid; place-items:center; font-size:.72rem; flex:none; }
  .pt-card p{ margin:0; font-size:.76rem; color:var(--ink-faint); line-height:1.4; flex:1; }
  .pt-row{ display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; }

  .pt-inp span{ color:var(--ink-faint); font-weight:800; }
