  .pt-foot{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:12px; font-size:.8rem; color:var(--ink-dim); }
  .pt-foot select{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel); color:var(--ink); border-radius:8px; padding:7px 10px; font:inherit; font-size:.82rem; }
  .sec-h{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:9px 14px; background:var(--panel-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); border-top:1px solid var(--line); font-size:.8rem; font-weight:800; color:var(--ink-dim); }
  .product-list > .sec-h:first-child{ border-top:0; }
  .sec-h .n{ margin-left:auto; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-faint); }
  .prod-empty.sm{ padding:14px; font-size:.82rem; background:var(--panel); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
  .prod-empty a{ color:var(--red); font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; }
  .vis.v-sm2{ width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:9px; --fs:1.25rem; flex:none; }
  .pm-row{ gap:10px; }
  .pm-chk, .pm-secchk, .pt-all input{ width:17px; height:17px; accent-color:var(--red); flex:none; margin:0; cursor:pointer; }
  .pm-old{ color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.85rem; font-weight:700; white-space:nowrap; min-width:78px; text-align:right; }
  .pm-row.chg .pm-old{ text-decoration:line-through; }
  .pm-arrow{ color:var(--ink-faint); }
  .pm-in{ display:flex; align-items:center; width:132px; border:1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius:9px; background:var(--panel-2); padding:0 9px; flex:none; }
  .pm-in:focus-within{ border-color:var(--ink-dim); background:var(--panel); }

  .pbar{ display:none; position:sticky; bottom:10px; z-index:20; margin-top:14px; align-items:center; gap:10px 12px; flex-wrap:wrap; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-left:4px solid var(--red); border-radius:12px; padding:12px 14px; box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.2); }
  .pbar.show{ display:flex; }
  .pb-info{ flex:1; min-width:200px; font-size:.86rem; color:var(--ink-dim); }

  @media (max-width:860px){

  .ol-by{ color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.74rem; font-weight:700; }
  .oc-by{ font-size:.74rem; color:var(--ink-dim); font-weight:700; margin:4px 0 0; }

  /* ===== v5: masa renkleri, tam ekran, mutfak, ödeme, taşıma ===== */
  .sm-pill,.plain-table-cell{ background:#fff; color:#1b1b1b; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .sm-pill.t-free,[data-theme="dark"] .plain-table-cell.t-free{ background:#f1efe9; }
  .sm-pill.t-blink,.plain-table-cell.t-blink{ animation:tblink 1s infinite; }
  @keyframes tblink{ 50%{ opacity:.45; } }
  .sm-pill.t-blink,.plain-table-cell.t-blink,.sm-pill.t-wait,.plain-table-cell.t-wait{ background:#d93025; border-color:#a8231a; color:#fff; }
  .sm-pill.t-ok,.plain-table-cell.t-ok{ background:#2e9d57; border-color:#217a42; color:#fff; }
  .t-blink .amt,.t-blink .bn,.plain-table-cell.t-blink .pencil,.sm-pill.t-wait .amt,.sm-pill.t-ok .amt,.plain-table-cell.t-wait .amt,.plain-table-cell.t-ok .amt,.plain-table-cell.t-wait .pencil,.plain-table-cell.t-ok .pencil,.t-wait .bn,.t-ok .bn{ color:#fff; }
  .sm-ic{ position:relative; user-select:none; }

  .sm-ic .cdot.ok{ background:#2e9d57; } .sm-ic .cdot.bad{ background:#d93025; } .sm-ic .cdot.loc{ background:#e0a340; }
  .sm-ic.on{ background:var(--red); color:#fff; border-color:var(--red); }
  .spin{ animation:smspin .7s linear; } @keyframes smspin{ to{ transform:rotate(360deg); } }
  .sm-size{ display:none; gap:8px; } body.sm-full .sm-size{ display:flex; }
  body.sm-full .sidebar, body.sm-full .topbar, body.sm-full .top-actions{ display:none !important; }

  body.sm-full .sm-pill{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:calc(var(--tsz,230px)/10); line-height:1.15; border-radius:14px; }
  body.sm-full .sm-pill .amt{ font-size:.6em; }

  body.kitchen-only .sidebar, body.kitchen-only .topbar, body.kitchen-only .eye-toggle, body.kitchen-only #btnCO, body.kitchen-only #btnKitchen, body.kitchen-only #rtMode, body.kitchen-only #screen-mutfak .panel-head{ display:none !important; }

  #restName{ pointer-events:none; user-select:none; background:transparent; border:0; }
  /* ödeme */
  #paymentPanel .pp-head{ background:transparent; border:0; max-width:600px; margin:0 auto; padding:18px 16px 4px; }
  #paymentPanel .pp-head b{ font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:800; }
  .pp-hero{ text-align:center; background:linear-gradient(160deg,#1f1b18,#3a2c25); color:#fff; border-radius:20px; padding:22px 18px 18px; box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
  .pp-hero .pp-rem-lbl{ font-size:.78rem; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; opacity:.7; font-weight:700; }

  .pp-prog{ height:8px; border-radius:99px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.18); overflow:hidden; }

  .pp-mini b{ font-weight:800; color:#fff; }
  .pp-card{ background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:16px; margin-bottom:14px; box-shadow:var(--shadow); }
  .pp-lbl{ font-size:.74rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-faint); margin-bottom:8px; }
  .pp-amt{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:var(--panel-2); border:2px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px; padding:6px 14px; }

  #paymentPanel .pp-amt input{ border:0; background:transparent; font-size:2rem; font-weight:900; width:100%; color:var(--ink); padding:8px 0; text-align:left; outline:none; margin:0; }
  .pp-chips{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-top:12px; }
  .pp-chip{ border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); border-radius:999px; padding:9px 16px; font-weight:700; font-size:.88rem; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; }
  .pp-chip:hover{ border-color:var(--sage); color:var(--sage); }

  .pp-stepper button{ width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; border:0; background:var(--panel); color:var(--ink); font-size:1.1rem; font-weight:800; cursor:pointer; }
  #paymentPanel .pp-stepper input{ width:34px; border:0; background:transparent; text-align:center; font-weight:800; font-size:1rem; padding:0; margin:0; color:var(--ink); -moz-appearance:textfield; }
  .pp-stepper input::-webkit-outer-spin-button,.pp-stepper input::-webkit-inner-spin-button{ -webkit-appearance:none; margin:0; }
  #paymentPanel .pp-split-row{ background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:14px 16px; margin-bottom:14px; }
  #paymentPanel .pp-split-controls select{ flex:1; padding:10px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink); font:inherit; }
  #paymentPanel .pp-methods{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); gap:12px; }
  #paymentPanel .pp-method{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:18px 10px; border:0; border-radius:16px; color:#fff; font-weight:800; font-size:1rem; box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.14); transition:transform .1s; }
  #paymentPanel .pp-method:hover{ color:#fff; filter:brightness(1.07); } #paymentPanel .pp-method:active{ transform:scale(.97); }
  #paymentPanel .pp-method .mi{ font-size:1.8rem; line-height:1; }
  .pp-method.m-nakit{ background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2e9d57,#1f7a41); }
  .pp-method.m-kart{ background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b6fd8,#2a50a8); }
  .pp-method.m-acik{ background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e0a340,#b97d1c); }
  .pp-method.m-diger{ background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6b5b95,#4a3d70); }
  #paymentPanel #btnWaive{ grid-column:1/-1; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-dim); border:1px dashed var(--line); box-shadow:none; flex-direction:row; justify-content:center; padding:12px; font-size:.9rem; }
  #paymentPanel #btnWaive:hover{ color:var(--ink); filter:none; }
  #paymentPanel .pp-history{ background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:6px 16px; margin-top:14px; }
  #paymentPanel .pp-history:empty{ display:none; }
  /* masa taşıma */
  .mvd-top{ display:flex; align-items:center; margin-bottom:12px; } .mvd-top h3{ margin:0; flex:1; } .mvd-top span{ cursor:pointer; font-size:20px; }
  .mvd-seg{ display:flex; background:var(--panel-2); border-radius:12px; padding:4px; margin-bottom:12px; }
  .mvd-seg button{ flex:1; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-dim); font:inherit; font-weight:800; padding:10px; border-radius:9px; cursor:pointer; }
  .mvd-seg button.on{ background:var(--red); color:#fff; }
  .mvd-list{ max-height:44vh; overflow:auto; }
  .mvd-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; margin-bottom:8px; background:var(--panel-2); opacity:.6; }
  .mvd-row.sel{ opacity:1; border-color:var(--red); }
  .mvd-row .nm{ flex:1; min-width:0; } .mvd-row .nm b{ display:block; } .mvd-row .nm small{ color:var(--ink-faint); font-weight:700; }
  .mvd-q{ font-weight:900; color:var(--red); font-size:1.1rem; }
  .mvd-go{ margin-top:10px; } .mvd-go:disabled{ opacity:.45; }
  .order-line .link-btn.mvl{ display:inline-block; margin:4px 0 0 12px; font-size:.78rem; }

<style id="pro-theme">
/* ==========================================================================
   İŞLETMEM — Kurumsal arayüz katmanı
   Tüm görünümü jetonlar (tokens) üzerinden yeniden tanımlar; iş mantığına dokunmaz.
   Palet: Gece mavisi (sidebar) · Kobalt (vurgu) · Çimen (olumlu) · Kehribar (uyarı) · Kiremit (zayi/gider)
   Yazı tipi: IBM Plex Sans — tabular rakamlar, Türkçe karakter desteği
   ========================================================================== */
:root{
  --bg:#F2F4F7; --panel:#FFFFFF; --panel-2:#F7F8FA;
  --ink:#0F1B2D; --ink-dim:#4A5A6E; --ink-faint:#76849A; --line:#E2E7EE;
  --red:#1F4B8F; --red-dark:#163A70;          /* eski "kırmızı" jeton = yeni kurumsal vurgu */
  --accent:#1F4B8F; --accent-soft:#E8EFFA; --accent-line:#C5D5EE;
  --ok:#157347; --ok-soft:#E5F4EC;
  --warn:#9A6200; --warn-soft:#FCF1DC;
  --bad:#B42318; --bad-soft:#FCE9E7;
  --sidebar-active:#E8EFFA;
  --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,27,45,.05);
  --shadow-lg:0 12px 32px rgba(15,27,45,.14);
  --r:10px;
}
[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#0B1322; --panel:#121C2F; --panel-2:#17233A;
  --ink:#E8EDF5; --ink-dim:#A7B3C6; --ink-faint:#7686A0; --line:#243350;
  --red:#6F9CE6; --red-dark:#9DBDF0;
  --accent:#6F9CE6; --accent-soft:#1A2A47; --accent-line:#2C4470;
  --ok:#4CC38A; --ok-soft:#12302A; --warn:#E5B04A; --warn-soft:#3A2D12;
  --bad:#F0847A; --bad-soft:#3A1B1A;
  --sidebar-active:#1A2A47; --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
}

/* ---------- Tipografi ---------- */
body{
  font-family:'IBM Plex Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.5; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
button,input,select,textarea{ font-family:inherit; }
.stat-card .value,.tile .t-value,.ct-kpi b,.ct-table,.prow .pval,.bar-row .bval,.order-total,.sm-pill .amt,.plain-table-cell .amt,.def-table{ font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.chart-card svg text{ font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif; }

/* ---------- Erişilebilir odak ---------- */
:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:6px; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ *{ transition:none !important; animation:none !important; } }

/* ---------- Kenar çubuğu: koyu kurumsal zemin ---------- */
.sidebar{
  --panel:#0F1A2C; --panel-2:#16243B; --ink:#E7ECF4; --ink-dim:#A9B6C9; --ink-faint:#74849D; --line:#22314B;
  --red:#8DB4F2; --red-dark:#FFFFFF;
  background:#0F1A2C; border-right:0;
}
[data-theme="dark"] .sidebar{ --panel:#0A1220; background:#0A1220; border-right:1px solid #1B2A44; }
.sb-top{ border-bottom:1px solid #22314B; }
.brand .name{ font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.04em; font-size:1rem; color:#fff; }
.nav-item{ border-radius:8px; font-weight:500; color:var(--ink-dim); }
.nav-item:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); color:#fff; }
.nav-item.active{ background:rgba(141,180,242,.16); color:#fff; font-weight:600; }
.nav-item.active::before{ background:#8DB4F2; width:3px; }
.nav-label{ color:var(--ink-faint); }
.nav-item .nb{ background:#E5B04A; color:#1B1405; }
.sb-foot button:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); }

/* ---------- Üst çubuk ---------- */
.topbar{ background:var(--panel); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); box-shadow:none; }
.topbar .title{ font-weight:600; font-size:1.05rem; letter-spacing:-.005em; }
.eye-toggle{ border-radius:8px; box-shadow:none; }

/* ---------- Kart sistemi ---------- */
.panel-card,.tile,.chart-card,.settings-card,.def-card,.ct-kpi,.stat-card,.order-card,.payment-panel{
  background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--r); box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.stat-card:hover,.chart-card:hover{ box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(15,27,45,.08); }
.panel-card{ padding:0; overflow:hidden; }
.panel-card > *:not(.panel-head){ margin-left:24px; margin-right:24px; }
.panel-card > .plist,.panel-card > .ct-tablewrap,.panel-card > .ct-chart,.panel-card > .def-table{ margin-left:0; margin-right:0; }
.panel-card > *:last-child{ margin-bottom:20px; }
.panel-card > .plist:last-child,.panel-card > .ct-tablewrap:last-child{ margin-bottom:0; }
.panel-head{ padding:18px 24px; margin-bottom:16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; }
.panel-head h2{ font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; margin:0; }
.panel-head p{ color:var(--ink-dim); font-size:.84rem; margin:2px 0 0; }
.panel-head p b{ color:var(--ink); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.panel-head .pi{
  width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:9px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); filter:grayscale(1); flex-shrink:0; font-size:16px;
}
.panel-head .btn-mini{ margin-left:auto; }
.chart-card{ padding:20px 22px; }
.chart-title{ font-size:.92rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:14px; }

/* ---------- Özet kartları: sakin, sol hizalı, üstte durum şeridi ---------- */
.stat-grid{ gap:16px; }
.stat-card{ flex-direction:row-reverse; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; padding:18px 20px 16px; border-top:3px solid var(--accent); }
.stat-card:has(.sw-2){ border-top-color:#0F7B8A; }
.stat-card:has(.sw-3){ border-top-color:#B7791F; }
.stat-card:has(.sw-4){ border-top-color:var(--bad); }
.stat-card .swatch{
  width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:9px; font-size:16px; background:var(--panel-2) !important; color:var(--ink-dim);
  filter:grayscale(1); border:1px solid var(--line);
}
.stat-card .info{ text-align:left; }
.stat-card .label{ color:var(--ink-dim); font-size:.82rem; font-weight:500; margin-bottom:6px; }
.stat-card .value{ font-size:1.75rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.02em; line-height:1.15; }
.stat-card .foot{ margin-top:12px; padding-top:10px; font-size:.78rem; }
.stat-card .foot[data-screen]{ color:var(--accent); text-decoration:none; font-weight:500; }
.stat-card .foot[data-screen]:hover{ text-decoration:underline; }
.tile .t-label{ font-size:.8rem; color:var(--ink-dim); }
.tile .t-value{ font-weight:600; }

/* ---------- Liste satırları (zayi, gider, vardiya, personel) ---------- */
.plist{ display:block; }
.prow{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:13px 24px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
.prow:first-child{ border-top:0; }
.prow:hover{ background:var(--panel-2); }
.prow .pic{
  width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:9px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); filter:grayscale(1); flex-shrink:0;
}
.prow .pmain b{ font-weight:600; font-size:.92rem; }
.prow .pmain span{ color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.8rem; }
.prow .pval{ margin-left:auto; font-weight:600; }
.prow .pval.tag{
  background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); border:1px solid var(--accent-line);
  padding:3px 10px; border-radius:6px; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:600;
}
.pcat{ color:var(--ink-faint); font-weight:600; font-size:.8rem; padding:14px 24px 6px; }

/* ---------- İlerleme çubukları ---------- */
.bar-row{ gap:14px; padding:10px 0; }
.bar-row .bname{ font-weight:500; color:var(--ink); }
.bar-row .btrack{ height:8px; background:#E8EDF4; border-radius:4px; }
[data-theme="dark"] .bar-row .btrack{ background:#1D2B45; }
.bar-row .bfill{ background:var(--accent); border-radius:4px; }
.bar-row .bval{ color:var(--ink); font-weight:600; width:80px; }

/* ---------- Tablolar ---------- */
.def-table,.ct-tablewrap{ border:0; box-shadow:none; border-radius:0; }
.def-table .dt-head,.ct-table thead th{
  background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink-dim); font-size:.74rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.02em; text-transform:none;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
}
.def-table .dt-row{ padding:13px 24px; }
.def-table .dt-row:hover{ background:var(--panel-2); }
.ct-table th,.ct-table td{ padding:11px 16px; }
.ct-table tbody tr:hover td{ background:var(--panel-2); }
.ct-table tfoot td{ background:var(--panel-2); border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
.badge{ border-radius:6px; font-weight:600; }

/* ---------- Rapor ve filtre alanları ---------- */
.ct-bar{ --ct-bar:#1F4B8F; --ct-bar-dim:#B4C7E6; }
[data-theme="dark"] .ct-bar{ --ct-bar:#6F9CE6; --ct-bar-dim:#2C4470; }
.ct-pills{ gap:8px; }
.ct-pill{ border-radius:8px; font-weight:500; background:var(--panel); padding:7px 14px; }
.ct-pill:hover{ border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent); }
.ct-pill.on{ background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); color:#fff; font-weight:600; }
[data-theme="dark"] .ct-pill.on{ color:#0B1322; }
.ct-seg{ border-radius:8px; background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); padding:3px; overflow:visible; }
.ct-seg button{ border:0 !important; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; font-weight:500; color:var(--ink-dim); padding:6px 14px; }
.ct-seg button.on{ background:var(--panel); color:var(--accent); font-weight:600; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,27,45,.12); }
.ct-range label{ color:var(--ink-dim); font-weight:500; font-size:.8rem; }
.ct-kpis{ gap:16px; }
.ct-kpi{ padding:16px 18px; }
.ct-kpi small{ font-weight:500; }
.ct-kpi b{ font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.015em; }
.ct-kpi.main{ border-color:var(--line); border-top:3px solid var(--accent); }
.ct-kpi em.up{ color:var(--ok); } .ct-kpi em.dn{ color:var(--bad); }
.ct-tip{ border-radius:8px; }
.cust-search,.sm-search,.cat-search-input{ border-radius:8px; }
.cust-filter{ border-radius:8px; }
.sm-switch{ border-radius:8px; background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); padding:3px; }
.sm-switch-btn{ border-radius:6px; font-weight:500; }
.sm-switch-btn.active,[data-theme="dark"] .sm-switch-btn.active{ background:var(--panel); color:var(--accent); font-weight:600; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,27,45,.12); }
.tabs .tab,.region-tab,.mp-tab,.c-tab{ font-weight:500; }
.tab.active,.region-tab.active,.mp-tab.active{ color:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); font-weight:600; }

/* ---------- Form alanları ve etkileşimli kontroller ---------- */
:where(input[type=text],input[type=number],input[type=date],input[type=search],input[type=password],input[type=email],input[type=tel],input:not([type]),select,textarea){
  border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--panel); color:var(--ink); padding:9px 12px;
}
:where(input,select,textarea):focus{ border-color:var(--accent); outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }
.field label{ font-weight:500; color:var(--ink-dim); font-size:.8rem; }
/* ---- Ayarlar: düzenli bölümler ---- */
.settings-head{padding:20px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.settings-head h2{margin:0;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:650}.settings-head p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-faint)}
.settings-head .btn-update{margin-left:auto}
.settings-card > .tabs{padding:0 24px;margin:0;gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--panel)}
.settings-card > .tabs .tab{padding:13px 16px;font-size:.9rem;white-space:nowrap}
.settings-card > div[id^="tab-"]{padding:22px 24px 8px;background:var(--panel-2,transparent)}
.sg{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px 6px;margin:0 0 18px;max-width:880px}
.sg > header{margin:0 0 16px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.sg > header h3{margin:0;font-size:.98rem;font-weight:650;color:var(--ink)}
.sg > header p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-faint);line-height:1.45}
.sg .field{margin:0 0 18px}
.sg .field label{display:block;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 4px}
.sg .field .hint{display:block;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--ink-faint);margin:-1px 0 8px;line-height:1.4}
.sg .field .val[contenteditable],.sg input.val{border:1px solid var(--line)!important;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px!important;background:var(--panel-2,var(--panel))!important;font-weight:600;min-height:42px;box-sizing:border-box;outline:none;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.sg .field .val[contenteditable]:focus,.sg input.val:focus{border-color:var(--accent,var(--red))!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(120,120,128,.18)}
.sg .field #sysStatus{font-weight:500;line-height:1.5}
.sg-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 16px}
.sg .btn-update{margin-top:10px}
.sg-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:0 0 16px}
.sg-danger{border-color:rgba(214,69,69,.4)}.sg-danger > header h3{color:#d64545}
.sg-pay .toggle-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:8px;background:var(--panel-2,var(--panel))}
.sg-pay .toggle-row .name{flex:1;font-weight:600;outline:none}
.chip{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:.82rem;cursor:pointer;background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink-dim);user-select:none}.chip.on{background:var(--accent,#1e4b8f);border-color:var(--accent,#1e4b8f);color:#fff}
/* ---- tam genişlik, sağ üst menü, bağlantı uyarısı, mutfak hazır uyarısı, garson görünümü ---- */
.content{max-width:none!important}.sg{max-width:none}
.top-actions #btnAsk,.top-actions #btnLogout,.top-actions .eye-toggle{display:none!important}
#userMenu{position:fixed;top:58px;right:12px;z-index:3000;width:272px;max-width:calc(100vw - 24px);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 14px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.24);padding:8px;transform-origin:top right;transform:scale(.92) translateY(-6px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:transform .16s,opacity .16s}
#userMenu.show{transform:none;opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.um-head{padding:8px 12px 6px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--ink-faint)}
.um-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink);user-select:none}
.um-item:hover{background:rgba(120,120,128,.13)}.um-item .um-ic{width:22px;text-align:center}.um-item .um-sw{margin-left:auto;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--ink-faint);font-weight:600}
.um-sw.on{color:#1f9d6a}.um-sep{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:6px 4px}.um-fs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-left:auto}.um-fs b{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:2px 10px;cursor:pointer}
#netBanner{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;pointer-events:none;display:none}
body.net-down #netBanner{display:block;animation:netBlink 1s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes netBlink{0%,100%{background:rgba(214,40,40,.06)}50%{background:rgba(214,40,40,.5)}}
#netBanner span{position:absolute;top:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#b71c1c;color:#fff;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.plain-table-cell.t-ready,.sm-pill.t-ready{background:#1f9d6a!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#1f9d6a!important;animation:readyBlink 1s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes readyBlink{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(31,157,106,0);filter:none}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(31,157,106,.55);filter:brightness(1.22) saturate(1.4)}}
.stg{display:block;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px;opacity:.92;white-space:normal;line-height:1.2}
#topLogo{display:none}
body.waiter-only #topLogo{display:flex;align-items:center;height:30px;margin-right:10px}body.waiter-only #topLogo svg{height:30px;width:auto}
body.waiter-only .sidebar,body.waiter-only #btnMenu{display:none!important}
body.waiter-only #screen-siparis-masa .sm-switch,body.waiter-only #smTabBolgeler,body.waiter-only #smTabSiparisler,body.waiter-only #smTabKapanan{display:none!important}
body.waiter-only .sm-pill .amt,body.waiter-only .plain-table-cell .amt{display:none!important}
body.req-alert .nav-item[data-screen="istekler"]{color:#ff5a5a!important;font-weight:700}body.req-alert .nav-item[data-screen="istekler"] .nb{background:#d62828;color:#fff;animation:readyBlink 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
body.req-alert .nav-label:has(+ .nav-accbody .nav-item[data-screen="istekler"]){color:#ff5a5a!important}
body.req-alert #btnUserMenu{position:relative;color:#d62828}body.req-alert #btnUserMenu::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#d62828;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--panel)}
body.waiter-only .content{padding:14px 12px 80px!important}
#kLogo{display:flex;align-items:center;margin-right:14px}#kLogo svg{height:34px;width:auto}

@media(max-width:720px){.sg-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.settings-card > div[id^="tab-"]{padding:14px 12px 4px}.settings-head{padding:16px 14px}.settings-card > .tabs{padding:0 8px;overflow-x:auto;flex-wrap:nowrap}.sg{padding:16px 14px 4px}}


/* Birincil eylemler */
.btn-mini,.btn-save,.btn-pay,.btn-add,.btn-update,#custGate button.go{
  background:var(--accent); color:#fff; border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:8px; font-weight:600; box-shadow:none;
}
[data-theme="dark"] .btn-mini,[data-theme="dark"] .btn-save,[data-theme="dark"] .btn-pay,[data-theme="dark"] .btn-add,[data-theme="dark"] .btn-update{ color:#0B1322; }
.btn-mini:hover,.btn-save:hover,.btn-pay:hover,.btn-add:hover,.btn-update:hover{ filter:brightness(1.1); }
.btn-pay{ background:var(--ok); border-color:var(--ok); }
.link-btn{ color:var(--accent); font-weight:500; }
.link-btn.muted{ color:var(--ink-dim); }
.del-btn,.cat-menu .cm-item.danger{ color:var(--bad); }
.del-btn:hover{ background:var(--bad-soft); }
.mini-toggle.on{ background:var(--accent); }
.chk.on{ background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); }
.info-box{ background:var(--accent-soft); border:1px solid var(--accent-line); color:var(--ink); border-radius:8px; }

/* ---------- Masa, sipariş, mutfak panelleri ---------- */
.table-cell,.plain-table-cell,.product-card,.mp-chip,.order-type-card,.sm-order-card,.sm-pill,.pp-method{
  border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--r); background:var(--panel); box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.table-cell:hover,.plain-table-cell:hover,.product-card:hover,.mp-chip:hover,.order-type-card:hover,.sm-order-card:hover,.sm-pill:hover,.pp-method:hover{ border-color:var(--accent); }
.table-cell.empty .dot{ background:var(--ok); }
.table-cell.busy .dot{ background:#C98A1B; }
.cat-item.active{ background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); font-weight:600; }
.sm-col-head{ font-weight:600; }
.sm-col-integ{ border-top:3px solid #0F7B8A; }
.sm-col-prep{ border-top:3px solid #C98A1B; }
.sm-col-wait{ border-top:3px solid var(--accent); }

/* ---------- Modal, bildirim ---------- */
.modal-bg{ background:rgba(15,27,45,.55); backdrop-filter:blur(2px); }
.modal-box,.modal-card{ border-radius:14px; border:1px solid var(--line); box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); }
.modal-card h2{ font-weight:600; font-size:1.1rem; }
.toast{ background:#0F1A2C; color:#fff; border-radius:8px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); font-weight:500; }

/* ---------- Mobil ---------- */
@media (max-width:720px){
  .stat-card .value{ font-size:1.45rem; }
  .panel-head{ padding:14px 16px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .prow,.def-table .dt-row{ padding:12px 16px; }
  .panel-card > *:not(.panel-head){ margin-left:16px; margin-right:16px; }
  .ct-kpi.main{ grid-column:span 1; }
}


/* ---------- Düzeltmeler: özet kartı yerleşimi, grafik renkleri, üst çubuk ---------- */
.stat-card{ position:relative; display:block; }
.stat-card .swatch{ position:absolute; top:16px; right:16px; font-size:15px; overflow:hidden; }
.stat-card:has(.sw-3) .swatch{ font-size:9px; letter-spacing:-1px; }
.stat-card .label{ padding-right:48px; min-height:2.6em; }
.stat-card .info{ width:100%; }
.staff-bar .mode:empty{ display:none; }
#dailySalesChart polyline{ stroke:var(--accent); stroke-width:2.25; stroke-linejoin:round; }
#dailySalesChart circle{ fill:var(--accent); r:3; stroke:var(--panel); stroke-width:1.5; }
.donut-legend .lg-item{ font-weight:500; color:var(--ink-dim); }

/* Sağ üst eylemler: sabit; çıkış yalnızca kenar çubuğunda */
#btnLogout{ display:none !important; }
.top-actions{ position:fixed !important; top:12px; right:16px; z-index:700; }
.topbar{ position:sticky; top:0; z-index:600; min-height:56px; }
.main{ min-width:0; }

/* Kenar çubuğu markası: logo, kenar çubuğunun kendi zemininde; sabit ve uyumlu */
.sidebar .brand{ padding:4px 6px 2px; }
.sidebar .sb-logo{ width:auto; height:auto; background:transparent; padding:0; border-radius:0; display:block; perspective:none; }
.sidebar .sb-logo svg{ animation:none !important; transform-style:flat; filter:none; width:auto; height:56px; max-height:none; margin:0; overflow:visible; }
.sb-top{ padding:18px 16px 16px; }
.brand-sub[hidden]{ display:none !important; }
/* Müşteri şifresi: Dijital Menü ekranında */
#screen-digitalmenu .cust-lock{ width:auto; max-width:460px; padding:12px 16px; margin-top:0; margin-bottom:16px; background:var(--panel-2); }
#screen-digitalmenu .cust-lock .cl-tx b{ font-size:.92rem; }
#screen-digitalmenu .cust-lock .cl-tx small{ font-size:.8rem; white-space:normal; }
#screen-digitalmenu .cust-lock .cl-act{ font-size:.8rem; font-weight:600; padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid var(--accent-line); border-radius:8px; background:var(--panel); }

/* CSV indirme önizlemesi */
.csvpv-bg{ position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:2000; background:rgba(15,27,45,.55); backdrop-filter:blur(2px); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:20px; }
.csvpv{ background:var(--panel); color:var(--ink); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); width:min(860px,100%); max-height:86vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden; }
.csvpv-h{ padding:18px 22px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); }
.csvpv-h h2{ margin:0; font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:600; }
.csvpv-h p{ margin:3px 0 0; color:var(--ink-dim); font-size:.84rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.csvpv-t{ overflow:auto; flex:1; min-height:80px; }
.csvpv-t table{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.84rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
.csvpv-t th,.csvpv-t td{ padding:9px 16px; text-align:left; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); white-space:nowrap; }
.csvpv-t th{ position:sticky; top:0; background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--ink-dim); font-weight:600; font-size:.76rem; }
.csvpv-t tbody tr:hover td{ background:var(--panel-2); }
.csvpv-e{ padding:36px 22px; text-align:center; color:var(--ink-dim); }
.csvpv-n{ padding:0 22px; color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.78rem; }
.csvpv-n:not(:empty){ padding-top:10px; }
.csvpv-b{ display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; padding:14px 22px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); }
.csvpv-b button{ border-radius:8px; padding:9px 18px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel); color:var(--ink); }
.csvpv-b .csvpv-ok{ background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); color:#fff; }
[data-theme="dark"] .csvpv-b .csvpv-ok{ color:#0B1322; }

/* ---------- Stok modülü ---------- */
.stk-head-btns{ margin-left:auto; display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.stk-head-btns .btn-mini{ margin-left:0; }
.stk-head-btns .btn-mini:not(:first-child){ background:var(--panel); color:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent-line); }
#stkBody{ margin-bottom:20px; }
#stkTabs{ display:flex; gap:4px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); margin-top:-4px; margin-bottom:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
#stkTabs .tab{ padding:10px 14px; cursor:pointer; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; margin-bottom:-1px; color:var(--ink-dim); }
#stkBody .ct-tablewrap{ border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; max-height:none; }
.stk-b{ display:inline-block; padding:2px 9px; border-radius:6px; font-size:.76rem; font-weight:600; border:1px solid transparent; }
.stk-b.bad{ background:var(--bad-soft); color:var(--bad); border-color:var(--bad); }
.stk-b.warn{ background:var(--warn-soft); color:var(--warn); }
.stk-b.ok{ background:var(--ok-soft); color:var(--ok); }
.stk-alert{ background:var(--bad-soft); border:1px solid var(--bad); color:var(--bad); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 16px; margin:0 0 16px; font-size:.88rem; line-height:1.6; }
.ct-kpi.stk-bad{ border-top:3px solid var(--bad); } .ct-kpi.stk-bad b{ color:var(--bad); }
.stk-bar{ width:64px; height:7px; border-radius:4px; background:#E8EDF4; overflow:hidden; display:inline-block; vertical-align:middle; }
[data-theme="dark"] .stk-bar{ background:#1D2B45; }
.stk-bar i{ display:block; height:100%; border-radius:4px; background:var(--ok); }
.stk-bar i.bad,.bfill.stk-bad{ background:var(--bad); } .stk-bar i.warn,.bfill.stk-warn{ background:#C98A1B; } .bfill.stk-ok{ background:var(--ok); }
.stk-act{ white-space:nowrap; }
#stkBody .ct-table th,#stkBody .ct-table td{ padding:10px 9px; }
.stk-act button{ padding:4px 5px !important; }
.stk-act button{ border:0; background:none; color:var(--accent); font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; padding:4px 7px; border-radius:6px; }
.stk-act button:hover{ background:var(--accent-soft); } .stk-act button.del{ color:var(--bad); }
.stk-row{ cursor:pointer; }
.stk-sub,.stk-note{ color:var(--ink-faint); font-size:.8rem; }
.stk-note{ margin:0 0 12px; }
.stk-empty{ text-align:center; padding:40px 20px; color:var(--ink-dim); }
.stk-h{ font-size:.92rem; font-weight:600; margin:22px 0 6px; }
.stk-r .bval{ width:190px; }
#sbStk{ background:var(--bad) !important; color:#fff !important; }
</style>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Quicksand:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style id="themeX">
@font-face{font-family:'Material Icons';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:block;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
/* ===== TEMA (yalnızca görsel katman) — "İşletmem" tasarımı; çalışma mantığına dokunmaz ===== */
.mi{font-family:'Material Icons';font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-size:22px;line-height:1;display:inline-block;letter-spacing:normal;text-transform:none;white-space:nowrap;word-wrap:normal;direction:ltr;-webkit-font-feature-settings:'liga';font-feature-settings:'liga';-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;vertical-align:middle}
body.staff{
  --bg:#f3f4f6;--panel:#fff;--panel-2:#f7f7f8;--ink:#37474f;--ink-dim:#5f6b73;--ink-faint:#8c969c;--line:#ececec;--red:#d32f2f;--red-dark:#b71c1c;--shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
  --sb-bg:#f5f5f5;--sb-ink:#292929;--sb-line:#e5e5e5;--sb-group:rgba(114,114,114,.165);--sb-act-bg:#ffedd5;--sb-act-ink:#c2410c;--tb-bg:#fff;--sbw:296px;
  font-family:'Quicksand','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;
}
body.staff[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#15130f;--panel:#1e1a15;--panel-2:#241f19;--ink:#f1e9de;--ink-dim:#b3a999;--ink-faint:#7d7364;--line:#332b21;--shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.45);--sb-bg:#1a1612;--sb-ink:#eadfce;--sb-line:#2c251d;--sb-group:rgba(255,255,255,.07);--sb-act-bg:rgba(246,147,34,.2);--sb-act-ink:#ffb36b;--tb-bg:#1e1a15}
body.staff input,body.staff select,body.staff textarea,body.staff button{font-family:inherit}

/* --- yan menü --- */
body.staff .sidebar{background:var(--sb-bg);color:var(--sb-ink);border-right:1px solid var(--sb-line);width:var(--sbw);flex:0 0 var(--sbw)}
body.staff .sb-top{padding:10px 14px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--sb-line);display:block;position:relative}

body.staff .sb-sub{margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-dim);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
body.staff .sb-sub small{font-size:11px;opacity:.7;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
body.staff .sb-nav{padding:0;overflow-y:auto}

body.staff .nav-item,body.staff .nav-label{height:48px;margin:0;padding:0 16px;border-radius:0;gap:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:var(--sb-ink);letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;line-height:1.2;box-sizing:border-box}
body.staff .nav-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--sb-line)}
body.staff .nav-sec > .nav-item:last-child,body.staff .nav-accbody > .nav-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}
body.staff .nav-item:hover{background:var(--sb-group)}
body.staff .nav-item .ic{display:inline-flex;width:24px;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;color:var(--ink-dim);flex-shrink:0}
body.staff .nav-item .ic .mi,body.staff .nav-label .ic .mi{font-size:21px}
body.staff .nav-item.active{background:var(--sb-act-bg);color:var(--sb-act-ink);font-weight:600}
body.staff .nav-item.active::before{display:none}
body.staff .nav-item.active .ic{color:var(--sb-act-ink)}
body.staff .nav-label{background:var(--sb-group);color:var(--sb-ink);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;margin:0}

body.staff .nav-label > span:first-of-type{flex:0 0 auto}

body.staff .nav-label span:not(.ic):not(.chev){flex:1}
body.staff .nav-label .chev,body.staff .nav-item .chev{margin-left:auto;display:inline-flex;font-size:0}
body.staff .nav-label .chev .mi,body.staff .nav-item .chev .mi{font-size:20px;color:var(--ink-dim);transition:transform .2s}
body.staff .nav-acc.open > .nav-label .chev .mi,body.staff .nav-fold.open > .nav-item .chev .mi{transform:rotate(180deg)}
body.staff .nav-accbody{border-left:0;margin:0;padding:0;background:transparent}

body.staff .sb-foot{background:var(--sb-bg);border-top:1px solid var(--sb-line);padding:10px 14px}

body.sb-collapsed.staff .sidebar{display:none}

/* --- üst çubuk --- */
body.staff .topbar{height:64px;padding:0 16px!important;background:var(--tb-bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);gap:10px;box-sizing:border-box}

body.staff .topbar .tb-ic{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--ink);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:0}

body.staff .staff-bar .mode{height:45px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:0 16px;border-radius:30px;background:#ebf6ff;color:#0056a8;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
body.staff[data-theme="dark"] .staff-bar .mode{background:rgba(0,86,168,.25);color:#9fd0ff}

/* --- içerik, kartlar, başlıklar --- */
body.staff .content{max-width:none!important;padding:34px 28px 60px}
body.staff .panel-card,body.staff .settings-card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:0 22px 22px;margin:38px 0 22px;overflow:visible}

body.staff .panel-head,body.staff .settings-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:0;margin:0 0 6px;padding:0 0 14px}

body.staff .panel-head .pi,body.staff .settings-head .icn{width:70px;height:75px;border-radius:3px;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-size:0;margin:-30px 18px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(60deg,#f69322,#d32f2f);box-shadow:0 4px 20px #00000024,0 7px 10px -5px #ffddaa41}
body.staff .panel-head .pi .mi,body.staff .settings-head .icn .mi{font-size:35px}

/* --- düğmeler --- */
body.staff .btn-update,body.staff .btn-add,body.staff .btn-save{background:#d32f2f;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:3px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2px;box-shadow:0 2px 2px 0 #c03a2b42,0 3px 1px -2px #c03a2b42,0 1px 5px 0 #c03a2b42;transition:box-shadow .2s,filter .2s}
body.staff .btn-update:hover,body.staff .btn-add:hover,body.staff .btn-save:hover{box-shadow:0 14px 26px -12px #c03a2b42,0 4px 23px #0000001f,0 8px 10px -5px #c03a2b42}

/* --- tablolar / listeler --- */

/* --- ana sayfa --- */

/* --- düzeltmeler --- */

body.staff .stat-card .swatch.sw-2,body.staff .stat-card .sw-2{background:linear-gradient(60deg,#26c6da,#0288d1)!important;color:#fff!important}
body.staff .stat-card .swatch.sw-3,body.staff .stat-card .sw-3{background:linear-gradient(60deg,#66bb6a,#2e7d32)!important;color:#fff!important}
body.staff .stat-card .swatch.sw-4,body.staff .stat-card .sw-4{background:linear-gradient(60deg,#ec407a,#ad1457)!important;color:#fff!important}
body.staff .stat-card .swatch .mi{color:#fff!important}
body.staff .staff-bar .mode{max-width:230px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
body.staff .sm-pill .stg{margin-top:4px}
body.staff .stat-card .swatch{filter:none!important;opacity:1!important}
</style>
</head>
<body data-theme="light">
  <div id="customerView">
    <div class="c-head"><div id="cLogo" class="c-logo"></div><div class="c-social" id="cSocial"></div></div>
    <div class="c-langs" id="cLang" style="display:none"></div>
    <div class="c-top"><div class="c-masa"><span>🪑 Masa</span><select id="cMasa"></select></div>
    <input id="cSearch" class="c-search" placeholder="🔍 Menüde ara…" autocomplete="off">
    <button type="button" class="c-aibtn" id="cAiBtn" style="display:none">💬 Menü Asistanı · ne yesem?</button>
    <div class="c-tabs" id="cTabs"></div><div class="c-tabs c-subs" id="cSubs" style="display:none"></div></div>
    <div id="cItems"></div>
    <div class="c-bar"><div class="c-bar-in">
      <div class="c-status" id="cStatus" style="display:none;"></div>
      <div id="cCartList" style="display:none"></div><input class="c-note" id="cNote" placeholder="Sipariş notu (isteğe bağlı)" style="display:none"><button type="button" class="c-noteai" id="cNoteAi" style="display:none">✨ Notu mutfak için düzenle</button>
      <button class="c-send" id="cSend" disabled>Sepet boş</button>
    </div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="modal-bg" id="loginModal"><div class="modal-box">
    <h3 style="margin:0;">Personel Girişi</h3>
    <input id="loginName" type="text" placeholder="Ad Soyad (kayıttaki gibi)" autocomplete="username" autocapitalize="words">
    <input id="loginPass" type="password" placeholder="Şifre" autocomplete="current-password">
    <div id="loginErr" style="color:var(--red);font-size:.85rem;min-height:18px;"></div>
    <div id="loginRecover" style="display:none;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ink-dim);background:rgba(120,120,128,.1);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;line-height:1.55"></div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;"><button class="btn-save" id="loginOk" style="margin:0;">Giriş</button><button class="btn-save" id="loginCancel" style="margin:0;background:var(--ink-faint);">Vazgeç</button></div>
  </div></div>
  <div class="modal-bg" id="coModal"><div class="modal-box">
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;"><h3 style="margin:0;flex:1;">🔔 Müşteri Siparişleri</h3><span id="coClose" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:20px;">✕</span></div>
    <div id="coList"></div>
  </div></div>


  <div id="printArea"></div>
  <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
  <div id="saveBanner" role="status" aria-live="polite"><div class="sb-ic">✓</div><div><div class="sb-t" id="sbT"></div><div class="sb-s" id="sbS"></div></div></div>

  <!-- Personel arayüzü ham HTML'de render edilmez: <template> içinde durur, yalnızca personel girişinden sonra sayfaya takılır -->
  <template id="staffTpl">
  <div class="top-actions">
    <div class="staff-bar">
      <span class="mode" id="rtMode"></span>
      <button class="ta-btn" id="btnCO" title="Siparişler" aria-label="Siparişler">🔔<span class="badge-n" id="coBadge">0</span></button>
      <button class="ta-btn" id="btnKitchen" title="Mutfak" aria-label="Mutfak">👨‍🍳<span class="badge-n" id="kBadge">0</span></button>
      <button class="ta-btn" id="btnAsk" title="Soru Sor (Yapay Zekâ)" aria-label="Soru Sor">❓</button>
      <button class="ta-btn" id="btnLogout" title="Çıkış" aria-label="Çıkış">⎋</button>
      <button class="ta-btn" id="btnUserMenu" title="Menü" aria-label="Menü">⋮</button>
    </div>
    <div class="eye-toggle" id="eyeToggle">
      <span class="icon" id="eyeIcon">☀️</span>
      <span class="track"><span class="knob"></span></span>
      <span id="eyeLabel">Göz dinlendirme</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="userMenu" role="menu" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="um-head" id="umWho"></div>
    <div class="um-item" data-um="ai"><span class="um-ic">✨</span>Yapay Zeka</div>
    <div class="um-item" data-um="night"><span class="um-ic">🌙</span>Gece Modu<span class="um-sw" id="umNight"></span></div>
    <div class="um-item" data-um="full"><span class="um-ic">⛶</span>Tam Ekran<span class="um-sw" id="umFull"></span></div>
    <div class="um-sep"></div>
    <div class="um-item" data-um="refresh"><span class="um-ic">↻</span>Yenile</div>
    <div class="um-item" data-um="sound"><span class="um-ic">🔔</span>Bildirim sesi<span class="um-sw" id="umSound"></span></div>
    <div class="um-item" data-um="awake"><span class="um-ic">💡</span>Ekran açık kalsın<span class="um-sw" id="umAwake"></span></div>
    <div class="um-item" data-um="font"><span class="um-ic">🔠</span>Yazı boyutu<span class="um-fs"><b data-fs="-1">A−</b><b data-fs="1">A+</b></span></div>
    <div class="um-sep"></div>
    <div class="um-item" data-um="logout" style="color:#d64545"><span class="um-ic">⎋</span>Çıkış</div>
  </div>
  <div id="netBanner"><span>⚠ İnternet bağlantısı yok</span></div>

            <div class="nav-sub">
              <div class="nav-item" data-screen="rapor-urun"><span class="ic">📈</span>Ürün Satışları</div>
              <div class="nav-item" data-screen="rapor-vardiya"><span class="ic">📄</span>Vardiya Satışları</div>

              <div class="nav-item" data-screen="rapor-istatistik"><span class="ic">◐</span>İstatistikler</div>
              <div class="nav-item" data-screen="rapor-fire"><span class="ic">🔥</span>Fire Raporu</div>
            </div>
          </div>

        <div class="nav-sec nav-acc">
          <div class="nav-label" role="button" tabindex="0"><span>Yönetim</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
          <div class="nav-accbody">
          <div class="nav-item" data-screen="tables"><span class="ic">▦</span>Masa / Bölgeler</div>
          <div class="nav-item" data-screen="users"><span class="ic">👥</span>Kullanıcılar</div>

          <div class="nav-item" data-screen="ai"><span class="ic">✨</span>Yapay Zekâ</div>
          <div class="nav-item" data-screen="istekler" style="display:none"><span class="ic">📥</span>İstekler Kutusu<span class="nb" id="reqBadge" style="display:none">0</span></div>
          <div class="nav-item" data-screen="settings"><span class="ic">⚙️</span>Ayarlar</div>

              <div class="nav-item" data-screen="kdv"><span class="ic">%</span>KDV Oranları</div>
              <div class="nav-item" data-screen="indirimler"><span class="ic">🏷️</span>İndirimler</div>

        <button id="sbLogout" type="button" title="Çıkış" aria-label="Çıkış">Çıkış</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MAIN -->
    <div class="main">
      <div class="topbar">
        <div class="tb-ic" id="btnMenu" title="Menü">☰</div>
        <div id="topLogo"></div>
        <div class="title" id="topTitle">Ana Sayfa</div>
        <div class="spacer"></div>
                        <div class="tb-ic" id="btnRefresh" title="Yenile">↻</div>
      </div>

      <div class="content">

        <!-- HOME -->
        <div class="screen show" id="screen-home">
          <div class="stat-grid">
            <div class="stat-card">
              <div class="swatch sw-1">◈</div>
              <div class="info">
                <div class="label">Bugünkü toplam satış tutarı</div>
                <div class="value" id="homeSalesValue">₺0,00</div>
                <div class="foot" data-screen="rapor-gunsonu">Gün sonu raporu</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
              <div class="swatch sw-2">👥</div>
              <div class="info">
                <div class="label">Bugün ağırlanan misafir sayısı</div>
                <div class="value" id="homeGuestValue">0</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
              <div class="swatch sw-3">▂▅█</div>
              <div class="info">
                <div class="label">Bugün açık sipariş toplamı</div>
                <div class="value" id="homeOpenOrderValue">₺0,00</div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="stat-card">
              <div class="swatch sw-4">⇅</div>
              <div class="info">
                <div class="label">Bugünkü toplam gider tutarı</div>
                <div class="value" id="homeExpenseValue">₺0,00</div>
                <div class="foot" data-screen="gider">Masraflar</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="chart-card">
            <div class="chart-title">Günlük Satış Miktarları</div>
            <div id="dailySalesChart"></div>
          </div>

          <div class="chart-row">
            <div class="chart-card" style="margin-top:0;">
              <div class="chart-title">Bugün Yapılan Ödemeler</div>
              <div id="paymentsChart"></div>
            </div>

            <div class="chart-card" style="margin-top:0;">
              <div class="chart-title">Masa Yoğunluğu (%)</div>
              <div id="occupancyChart"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- SETTINGS -->
        <div class="screen" id="screen-settings">
          <div class="settings-card">
            <div class="settings-head">
              <div class="icn">⚙️</div>
              <div>
                <h2>Ayarlar</h2>
                <p>İşletme bilgileri, ödeme yöntemleri ve güvenlik</p>
              </div>
              <button class="btn-update" id="btnGuncelle">💾 Güncelle</button>
            </div>
            <div class="tabs">
              <div class="tab active" data-tab="genel">Genel</div>
              <div class="tab" data-tab="odeme">Ödeme</div>
              <div class="tab" data-tab="guvenlik">Güvenlik</div>
              <div class="tab" data-tab="gunluk" id="tabGunluk" style="display:none">İşlem günlüğü</div>
              <div class="tab" data-tab="marka" id="tabMarka" style="display:none">🎨 Marka &amp; Logo</div>
            </div>

<div id="tab-genel">
              <section class="sg"><header><h3>İşletme</h3><p>Menüde ve raporlarda görünen temel bilgiler</p></header>
                <div class="field"><label>İşletme adı</label><div class="val" id="setRestName" contenteditable="true"></div></div>
              </section>
              <section class="sg"><header><h3>Gün ve vardiya düzeni</h3><p>Gün sonu raporu ve adisyon numaralandırması bu değerlere göre çalışır</p></header>
                <div class="sg-grid"><div class="field"><label>Gün başlangıç saati</label><small class="hint">Gün sonu raporu bu saatte başlar</small><div class="val" id="setDayStart" contenteditable="true">05:00</div></div><div class="field"><label>Vardiya değişim saati</label><small class="hint">Sabah / akşam ayrımı</small><div class="val" id="setShift" contenteditable="true">15:00</div></div><div class="field"><label>İlk adisyon no</label><small class="hint">Numaralandırma buradan başlar</small><div class="val" id="setFirstOrderNo" contenteditable="true">101</div></div></div>
              </section>
              <section class="sg"><header><h3>Müşteri menüsü</h3><p>Müşterilerin menüde göreceği bağlantılar</p></header>
                <div class="field" id="wifiBlock"><label>Wi-Fi — müşteri menüsünde göster</label><div class="toggle-row" style="border:0;padding:6px 0"><div class="mini-toggle on" id="wifiOnTgl" role="switch" aria-checked="true" tabindex="0" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="k"></span></div><div class="name">Menüde Wi-Fi butonu görünsün</div></div><label style="margin-top:8px">Ağ adı</label><div class="val" id="setWifiName" contenteditable="true"></div><label style="margin-top:8px">Şifre (menüde görünür ve müşteri tek dokunuşla kopyalar)</label><div class="val" id="setWifiPass" contenteditable="true"></div><button class="btn-update" id="btnWifiSave" type="button" style="margin-top:10px">📶 Wi-Fi'yi güncelle</button></div>
                <div class="field" id="socialBlock"><label>Sosyal medya — hesabınız varsa açın, kullanıcı adını yazın; menüde simge olarak görünür, dokununca hesabınıza gider</label><div id="socRows"><div class="toggle-row"><div class="mini-toggle off" data-soc-t="instagram" role="switch" aria-checked="false" tabindex="0" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="k"></span></div><div class="name" style="flex:0 0 130px">Instagram</div><input class="val" data-soc-v="instagram" placeholder="kullanıcı adı" autocomplete="off" style="flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"></div><div class="toggle-row"><div class="mini-toggle off" data-soc-t="tiktok" role="switch" aria-checked="false" tabindex="0" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="k"></span></div><div class="name" style="flex:0 0 130px">TikTok</div><input class="val" data-soc-v="tiktok" placeholder="kullanıcı adı" autocomplete="off" style="flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"></div><div class="toggle-row"><div class="mini-toggle off" data-soc-t="facebook" role="switch" aria-checked="false" tabindex="0" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="k"></span></div><div class="name" style="flex:0 0 130px">Facebook</div><input class="val" data-soc-v="facebook" placeholder="sayfa adı" autocomplete="off" style="flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"></div><div class="toggle-row"><div class="mini-toggle off" data-soc-t="x" role="switch" aria-checked="false" tabindex="0" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="k"></span></div><div class="name" style="flex:0 0 130px">X (Twitter)</div><input class="val" data-soc-v="x" placeholder="kullanıcı adı" autocomplete="off" style="flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"></div><div class="toggle-row"><div class="mini-toggle off" data-soc-t="youtube" role="switch" aria-checked="false" tabindex="0" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="k"></span></div><div class="name" style="flex:0 0 130px">YouTube</div><input class="val" data-soc-v="youtube" placeholder="kanal adı" autocomplete="off" style="flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"></div><div class="toggle-row"><div class="mini-toggle off" data-soc-t="whatsapp" role="switch" aria-checked="false" tabindex="0" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="k"></span></div><div class="name" style="flex:0 0 130px">WhatsApp</div><input class="val" data-soc-v="whatsapp" placeholder="telefon (905xxxxxxxxx)" autocomplete="off" style="flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"></div><div class="toggle-row"><div class="mini-toggle off" data-soc-t="maps" role="switch" aria-checked="false" tabindex="0" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="k"></span></div><div class="name" style="flex:0 0 130px">Konum (Harita)</div><input class="val" data-soc-v="maps" placeholder="Google Haritalar bağlantısı veya adres" autocomplete="off" style="flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"></div><div class="toggle-row"><div class="mini-toggle off" data-soc-t="web" role="switch" aria-checked="false" tabindex="0" style="cursor:pointer"><span class="k"></span></div><div class="name" style="flex:0 0 130px">Web sitesi</div><input class="val" data-soc-v="web" placeholder="www.siteniz.com" autocomplete="off" style="flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"></div></div><button class="btn-update" id="btnSocSave" type="button" style="margin-top:10px">🔗 Sosyal medyayı güncelle</button></div>
              </section>
            </div>
            <div id="tab-guvenlik" style="display:none;">
              <section class="sg"><header><h3>Giriş ve şifre</h3><p>Hesap güvenliği ve kurtarma seçenekleri</p></header>
                <div class="field" id="ownerPwField"><label id="ownerPwLbl" data-keep="1">Şifremi değiştir (yeni şifre en az 6 karakter. Eski şifreyi unuttuysanız Google ile girdikten hemen sonra eski şifre alanını boş bırakın)</label><input type="password" class="val" id="ownerOldPw" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="Eski şifre" style="width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"><input type="password" class="val" id="ownerNewPw" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Yeni şifre" style="width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit;margin-top:6px"><button class="btn-update" id="btnOwnerPw" style="margin-top:8px;">🔑 Şifremi değiştir</button></div>
                <div class="field" id="ownerGoogleField"><label>Kurtarma Google hesabı</label><small class="hint">Şifrenizi unutursanız bu hesapla giriş yapıp yeni şifre belirleyebilirsiniz</small><div class="val" id="ownerGoogleInfo" style="padding:6px 0"></div><button class="btn-update" id="btnOwnerGoogle" style="margin-top:8px;">🔗 Google hesabını bağla / değiştir</button></div>
                <div class="field" id="ownerAccField"><label>Yönetici hesabı şifresi</label><small class="hint">En az 6 karakter. Şifre unutulduysa buradan yenisi belirlenir</small><input type="password" class="val" id="setOwnerPw" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Yönetici için yeni şifre" style="width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"><button class="btn-update" id="btnOwnerAcc" style="margin-top:8px;">🔑 Yönetici hesabını kaydet</button></div>
                <div class="field" id="supPinField"><label>Özel PIN</label><small class="hint">En az 6 karakter</small><input type="password" class="val" id="setSupPin" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Admin PIN'i belirlemek/değiştirmek için yazın" style="width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"></div>
                <div class="field"><label>Yönetici PIN</label><small class="hint">Bu cihazdaki personel girişi için, en az 4 hane</small><input type="password" class="val" id="setPin" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Değiştirmek için yeni PIN yazın (en az 4 hane)" style="width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;font:inherit;color:inherit"></div>
              </section>

            <div class="plist">
              <div class="prow"><span class="pic">🌅</span><div class="pmain"><b>Sabah Vardiyası</b><span id="vSabahLbl">Gün başlangıcı – 15:00</span></div><span class="pval" id="vSabah">₺0,00</span></div>
              <div class="prow"><span class="pic">🌙</span><div class="pmain"><b>Akşam Vardiyası</b><span id="vAksamLbl">15:00 – gün sonu</span></div><span class="pval" id="vAksam">₺0,00</span></div>

        <div class="screen" id="screen-rapor-personel">
          <style>.pr-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.88rem}.pr-table th{text-align:right;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-faint);font-size:.76rem;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}.pr-table td{text-align:right;padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}.pr-table th:first-child,.pr-table td:first-child{text-align:left;padding-left:24px}</style>
          <div class="panel-card">
            <div class="panel-head"><div class="pi">👥</div><div><h2>Personel Raporu</h2><p>Personele göre kapattığı fiş, ciro, girdiği ürün, iptal, ikram ve iade</p></div><button class="btn-mini" id="prCsv">↓ CSV</button></div>

            <div class="kp-bar" style="margin:0 24px 12px"><div class="kp-chips"><button type="button" data-stq="1">Bugün</button><button type="button" data-stq="y">Dün</button><button type="button" data-stq="7">7 gün</button><button type="button" data-stq="30">30 gün</button><button type="button" data-stq="90">90 gün</button><button type="button" data-stq="365">1 yıl</button><button type="button" data-stq="all">Tümü</button></div><label>Başlangıç<input type="date" id="stFrom"></label><label>Bitiş<input type="date" id="stTo"></label></div>

            <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin:6px 0 12px"><label>Başlangıç <input type="date" id="fireFrom"></label><label>Bitiş <input type="date" id="fireTo"></label><button class="btn-mini" id="fireCsv">⬇ CSV</button></div>
            <div class="plist" id="repFire"></div>
