    const n = !x; x = x || { name: '', unit: 'gr', qty: 0, min: 0, cost: 0, sup: '' };
    openForm({ title: n ? 'Yeni malzeme' : 'Malzemeyi düzenle', sub: 'Reçetelerde kullanılacak ham madde veya sarf malzemesi.', fields: [
      { id: 'name', label: 'Malzeme adı', value: x.name, placeholder: 'Örn. Nargile tütünü (elma)' },
      { id: 'unit', label: 'Birim', type: 'select', options: stkUnits, value: x.unit },
      { id: 'qty', label: 'Mevcut stok (açılış)', type: 'number', step: '0.01', value: x.qty },
      { id: 'min', label: 'Kritik seviye (altında uyarı verir)', type: 'number', step: '0.01', value: x.min },
      { id: 'cost', label: 'Birim maliyet (₺)', type: 'number', step: '0.01', value: x.cost },
      { id: 'sup', label: 'Tedarikçi', value: x.sup || '' }
    ].filter(f => n || f.id !== 'qty'), onOk(v){
      if(!v.name) return 'Malzeme adı gerekli.';
      const d = stkByName(v.name); if(d && d !== x) return 'Bu isimde bir malzeme zaten var.';
      if(!(v.min >= 0) || !(v.cost >= 0)) return 'Kritik seviye ve maliyet 0 veya daha büyük olmalı.';
      if(n){ const it = { id: stkId(), name: v.name, unit: v.unit, qty: 0, min: v.min, cost: v.cost, sup: v.sup }; STK.items.push(it); if(v.qty > 0) stkMove('in', it, v.qty, 'Açılış stoku'); }
      else Object.assign(x, { name: v.name, unit: v.unit, min: v.min, cost: v.cost, sup: v.sup });
      stkSave();
    } });
  }
  function stkInForm(id){
    if(!STK.items.length) return showToast('Önce bir malzeme ekleyin.');
    const x = stkItem(id) || STK.items[0];
    openForm({ title: 'Mal kabul', sub: 'Tedarikçi faturasındaki alış stoğa eklenir.', fields: [
      stkPick(x.name), { id: 'qty', label: 'Gelen miktar', type: 'number', step: '0.01', value: '' },
      { id: 'price', label: 'Birim alış fiyatı (₺)', type: 'number', step: '0.01', value: x.cost },
      { id: 'inv', label: 'Fatura / irsaliye no (isteğe bağlı)', value: '' },
      { id: 'last', type: 'checkbox', label: 'Birim maliyet', text: 'Maliyeti son alış fiyatına eşitle (kapalıysa ağırlıklı ortalama)', value: false }
    ], onOk(v){
      const it = stkByName(v.item); if(!it) return 'Malzeme seçin.';
      if(!(v.qty > 0)) return 'Miktar 0’dan büyük olmalı.';
      if(!(v.price >= 0)) return 'Birim fiyat geçersiz.';
      stkApplyIn(it, v.qty, v.price, v.inv ? 'Fatura ' + v.inv : 'Mal kabul', v.last); stkSave(); showToast(it.name + ' stoğa eklendi.');
    } });
  }
  function stkBulkForm(){
    openForm({ title: 'Toplu stok girişi', sub: 'Her satıra: malzeme; miktar; birim fiyat (fiyat boşsa mevcut maliyet kullanılır).', fields: [
      { id: 'txt', type: 'textarea', label: 'Satırlar', value: '' }
    ], onOk(v){
      const miss = [], ok = [];
      v.txt.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(l => {
        const p = l.split(';'), it = stkByName(p[0]), q = stkN(p[1]), pr = p[2] == null || p[2].trim() === '' ? NaN : stkN(p[2]);
        if(!it || !(q > 0)) miss.push(l); else ok.push([it, q, pr]);
      });
      if(miss.length) return 'Okunamayan satır: ' + miss[0];
      if(!ok.length) return 'Satır yok.';
      ok.forEach(a => stkApplyIn(a[0], a[1], a[2], 'Toplu giriş')); stkSave(); showToast(ok.length + ' kalem stoğa eklendi.');
    } });
  }
  function stkFireForm(id){
    if(!STK.items.length) return showToast('Önce bir malzeme ekleyin.');
    const x = stkItem(id) || STK.items[0];
    openForm({ title: 'Fire / zayi işle', sub: 'Stoktan düşülür ve maliyet raporuna yansır.', fields: [
      stkPick(x.name), { id: 'qty', label: 'Miktar', type: 'number', step: '0.01', value: '' },
      { id: 'reason', label: 'Neden', type: 'select', options: ['Zayi / Fire Kaydı', 'Döküldü', 'Bozuldu', 'Kırıldı', 'Son kullanma tarihi geçti', 'Mutfak hatası', 'Diğer'], value: 'Zayi / Fire Kaydı' },
      { id: 'desc', label: 'Açıklama (“Diğer” seçilirse zorunlu)', type: 'textarea', value: '' }
    ], onOk(v){
      const it = stkByName(v.item); if(!it) return 'Malzeme seçin.';
      if(v.reason === 'Diğer' && !String(v.desc || '').trim()) return '“Diğer” seçildiğinde açıklama girmek zorunludur.';
      if(!(v.qty > 0)) return 'Miktar 0’dan büyük olmalı.';
      if(v.qty > it.qty) return 'Stokta yalnızca ' + stkFmt(it.qty) + ' ' + it.unit + ' var.';
      stkMove('fire', it, -v.qty, v.reason);
      { const ds = String(v.desc || '').trim(); lists.zayi.push({ name: it.name, qty: v.qty, ts: Date.now(), cost: Math.round(v.qty * (+it.cost || 0) * 100) / 100, reason: v.reason, desc: ds, sub: new Date().toLocaleDateString('tr-TR') + ' · ' + v.reason + (ds ? ' · ' + ds : ''), val: stkFmt(v.qty) + ' ' + it.unit + ' (' + money(v.qty * it.cost) + ')' }); }
      try{ renderLists(); renderReports(); }catch(_){}
      stkSave(); showToast('Fire işlendi.');
    } });
  }
  function stkCountForm(id){
    const x = stkItem(id); if(!x) return;
    openForm({ title: 'Sayım düzeltmesi: ' + x.name, sub: 'Sistemdeki stok: ' + stkFmt(x.qty) + ' ' + x.unit + '. Raflarda saydığınız gerçek miktarı girin.', fields: [
      { id: 'qty', label: 'Sayılan miktar (' + x.unit + ')', type: 'number', step: '0.01', value: x.qty }
    ], onOk(v){
      if(!(v.qty >= 0)) return 'Geçerli bir miktar girin.';
      const d = v.qty - x.qty; if(d !== 0) stkMove('adj', x, d, 'Sayım farkı'); stkSave();
    } });
  }
  function stkRecForm(p){
    if(!STK.items.length) return showToast('Önce malzeme ekleyin.');
    const cur = (STK.rec[p.name] || []).map(r => { const x = stkItem(r.id); return x ? x.name + '; ' + r.q : ''; }).filter(Boolean).join('\n');
    openForm({ title: 'Reçete: ' + p.name, sub: 'Her satıra: malzeme; bir porsiyondaki miktar. Satış yapıldıkça stoktan otomatik düşer.', fields: [
      { id: 'txt', type: 'textarea', label: 'Malzemeler (' + stkNames().slice(0, 4).join(', ') + '…)', value: cur }
    ], onOk(v){
      const out = [];
      for(const l of v.txt.split('\n').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)){
        const a = l.split(';'), it = stkByName(a[0]), q = stkN(a[1]);
        if(!it) return 'Tanımsız malzeme: ' + a[0].trim();
        if(!(q > 0)) return 'Miktar geçersiz: ' + l;
        out.push({ id: it.id, q });
      }
      if(out.length) STK.rec[p.name] = out; else delete STK.rec[p.name];
      stkSave();
    } });
  }
  function stkSeed(){
    [['Nargile tütünü', 'gr', 5000, 500, 0.6], ['Kömür', 'Adet', 400, 80, 0.5], ['Folyo', 'Adet', 300, 50, 0.3], ['Kahve çekirdeği', 'gr', 3000, 500, 0.9], ['Süt', 'lt', 20, 5, 38], ['Kağıt bardak', 'Adet', 500, 100, 1.2]]
      .forEach(a => { if(!stkByName(a[0])){ const it = { id: stkId(), name: a[0], unit: a[1], qty: 0, min: a[3], cost: a[4], sup: '' }; STK.items.push(it); stkMove('in', it, a[2], 'Açılış stoku'); } });
    stkSave();
  }
  // ---- görünümler ----
  function stkViewStock(){
    const L = STK.items, crit = L.filter(x => x.qty <= x.min), val = L.reduce((a, x) => a + Math.max(0, x.qty) * x.cost, 0);
    const noRec = stkProds().filter(p => !(STK.rec[p.name] || []).length).length;
    if(!L.length) return '<div class="stk-empty">Henüz malzeme yok. Malzemeleri tek tek ekleyebilir ya da örnek bir başlangıç listesi yükleyebilirsiniz.<br><button class="btn-mini" data-a="seed" style="margin-top:12px">Örnek malzemeleri ekle</button></div>';
    let h = '<div class="ct-kpis"><div class="ct-kpi"><small>Malzeme çeşidi</small><b>' + L.length + '</b></div><div class="ct-kpi' + (crit.length ? ' stk-bad' : '') + '"><small>Kritik / tükenen</small><b>' + crit.length + '</b></div><div class="ct-kpi"><small>Stok değeri</small><b>' + money(val) + '</b></div><div class="ct-kpi"><small>Reçetesiz ürün</small><b>' + noRec + '</b><em>Satışta stoktan düşmez</em></div></div>';
    if(crit.length) h += '<div class="stk-alert"><b>Stok uyarısı:</b> ' + crit.map(x => esc(x.name) + ' (' + stkFmt(x.qty) + ' ' + esc(x.unit) + ')').join(' · ') + '</div>';
    h += '<div class="ct-tablewrap"><table class="ct-table"><thead><tr><th>Malzeme</th><th>Durum</th><th>Seviye</th><th>Stok</th><th>Kritik</th><th>Birim maliyet</th><th>Değer</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
      L.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.qty / (a.min || 1)) - (b.qty / (b.min || 1))).map(x => {
        const s = stkState(x), pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, x.min ? x.qty / (x.min * 3) * 100 : (x.qty > 0 ? 100 : 0)));
        return '<tr><td><b>' + esc(x.name) + '</b>' + (x.sup ? '<br><small class="stk-sub">' + esc(x.sup) + '</small>' : '') + '</td><td><span class="stk-b ' + s[0] + '">' + s[1] + '</span></td><td><div class="stk-bar"><i class="' + s[0] + '" style="width:' + pct + '%"></i></div></td><td>' + stkFmt(x.qty) + ' ' + esc(x.unit) + '</td><td>' + stkFmt(x.min) + '</td><td>' + money(x.cost) + '</td><td>' + money(Math.max(0, x.qty) * x.cost) + '</td><td class="stk-act"><button data-a="in" data-id="' + x.id + '">Giriş</button><button data-a="fire" data-id="' + x.id + '">Fire</button><button data-a="count" data-id="' + x.id + '">Sayım</button><button data-a="edit" data-id="' + x.id + '">Düzenle</button><button data-a="del" data-id="' + x.id + '" class="del">Sil</button></td></tr>';
      }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
    return h;
  }
  function stkViewRecipes(){
    const P = stkProds();
    return '<p class="stk-note">Ürüne tıklayarak reçetesini girin. Maliyet, malzemelerin güncel birim maliyetinden hesaplanır.</p><div class="ct-tablewrap"><table class="ct-table"><thead><tr><th>Ürün</th><th>Kalem</th><th>Reçete maliyeti</th><th>Satış fiyatı</th><th>Kâr marjı</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>' + P.map((p, i) => {
      const R = STK.rec[p.name] || [], c = R.reduce((a, r) => { const x = stkItem(r.id); return a + (x ? x.cost * r.q : 0); }, 0), pr = +p.price || 0, mg = pr > 0 && R.length ? (pr - c) / pr * 100 : null;
      return '<tr class="stk-row" data-a="rec" data-i="' + i + '"><td><b>' + esc(p.name) + '</b></td><td>' + (R.length ? R.length : '<span class="stk-b warn">Reçete yok</span>') + '</td><td>' + (R.length ? money(c) : '—') + '</td><td>' + money(pr) + '</td><td>' + (mg == null ? '—' : '<span class="stk-b ' + (mg < 40 ? 'bad' : mg < 60 ? 'warn' : 'ok') + '">%' + mg.toFixed(0) + '</span>') + '</td><td class="stk-act"><button data-a="rec" data-i="' + i + '">Reçete</button></td></tr>';
    }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>';
  }
  function stkAgg(){
    const f = new Date(stkR.f + 'T00:00:00').getTime(), t = new Date(stkR.t + 'T00:00:00').getTime() + 864e5, m = {}, T = { cons: 0, fire: 0, buy: 0 };
    STK.log.forEach(e => {
      if(e.ts < f || e.ts >= t) return; const x = stkItem(e.id); if(!x) return;
      const o = m[e.id] || (m[e.id] = { x, s: 0, sc: 0, f: 0, fc: 0, b: 0 }), c = Math.abs(e.q) * e.c;
      if(e.t === 'sale'){ o.s -= e.q; o.sc += c; T.cons += c; } else if(e.t === 'fire'){ o.f -= e.q; o.fc += c; T.fire += c; } else if(e.t === 'in'){ o.b += e.q; T.buy += e.q * e.c; }
    });
    return { rows: Object.values(m), T };
  }
  function stkViewReport(){
    const { rows, T } = stkAgg();
    const bars = (arr, key, fmt) => { const mx = Math.max(1e-9, ...arr.map(o => o[key])); return arr.map(o => '<div class="bar-row"><div class="bname">' + esc(o.x.name) + '</div><div class="btrack"><div class="bfill" style="width:' + (o[key] / mx * 100) + '%"></div></div><div class="bval">' + fmt(o) + '</div></div>').join('') || '<p class="stk-note">Bu aralıkta kayıt yok.</p>'; };
    const low = STK.items.filter(x => x.min > 0).map(x => ({ x, r: Math.max(0, x.qty / x.min) })).sort((a, b) => a.r - b.r).slice(0, 6);
    return '<div class="ct-range"><label>Başlangıç<input type="date" id="stkFrom" data-r="f" value="' + stkR.f + '"></label><label>Bitiş<input type="date" id="stkTo" data-r="t" value="' + stkR.t + '"></label><button class="btn-mini" data-a="csv" style="margin-left:auto">⬇ CSV</button></div>' +
      '<div class="ct-kpis"><div class="ct-kpi"><small>Tüketim maliyeti</small><b>' + money(T.cons) + '</b></div><div class="ct-kpi' + (T.fire > 0 ? ' stk-bad' : '') + '"><small>Fire maliyeti</small><b>' + money(T.fire) + '</b><em>Fire oranı %' + ((T.cons + T.fire) ? (T.fire / (T.cons + T.fire) * 100).toFixed(1) : '0') + '</em></div><div class="ct-kpi"><small>Mal alımı</small><b>' + money(T.buy) + '</b></div></div>' +
      '<div class="stk-r"><h3 class="stk-h">En çok tüketilen malzemeler</h3>' + bars(rows.filter(o => o.s > 0).sort((a, b) => b.sc - a.sc).slice(0, 8), 'sc', o => stkFmt(o.s) + ' ' + esc(o.x.unit) + ' · ' + money(o.sc)) +
      '<h3 class="stk-h">Fire (zayi) maliyeti</h3>' + bars(rows.filter(o => o.f > 0).sort((a, b) => b.fc - a.fc).slice(0, 6), 'fc', o => stkFmt(o.f) + ' ' + esc(o.x.unit) + ' · ' + money(o.fc)) +
      '<h3 class="stk-h">Seviyesi en düşük malzemeler</h3>' + (low.map(o => '<div class="bar-row"><div class="bname">' + esc(o.x.name) + '</div><div class="btrack"><div class="bfill stk-' + stkState(o.x)[0] + '" style="width:' + Math.min(100, o.r * 50) + '%"></div></div><div class="bval">' + stkFmt(o.x.qty) + ' ' + esc(o.x.unit) + '</div></div>').join('') || '<p class="stk-note">Kritik seviye tanımlı malzeme yok.</p>') + '</div>';
  }
  function stkViewLog(){
    const L = STK.log.slice(-100).reverse();
    return L.length ? '<div class="ct-tablewrap"><table class="ct-table"><thead><tr><th>Tarih</th><th>Malzeme</th><th>İşlem</th><th>Miktar</th><th>Not</th><th>Kullanıcı</th></tr></thead><tbody>' + L.map(e => { const x = stkItem(e.id); return '<tr><td>' + new Date(e.ts).toLocaleString('tr-TR', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) + '</td><td>' + esc(x ? x.name : '(silinmiş)') + '</td><td>' + (stkLbl[e.t] || e.t) + '</td><td>' + (e.q > 0 ? '+' : '') + stkFmt(e.q) + '</td><td>' + esc(e.note) + '</td><td>' + esc(e.u || '') + '</td></tr>'; }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>' : '<div class="stk-empty">Henüz hareket yok.</div>';
  }
  function stkRender(){
    try{ stkLiveRender(); }catch(err){ console.error(err); }
    const el = $id('stkBody'); if(!el) return; stkBadge();
    if(stkMode !== 'adv') return;
    document.querySelectorAll('#stkTabs .tab').forEach(t => t.classList.toggle('active', t.dataset.t === stkTab));
    el.innerHTML = ({ stok: stkViewStock, recete: stkViewRecipes, rapor: stkViewReport, hareket: stkViewLog })[stkTab]();
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const tb = e.target.closest('#stkTabs .tab'); if(tb){ stkTab = tb.dataset.t; return stkRender(); }
    const b = e.target.closest('#screen-stok [data-a]'); if(!b) return; e.stopPropagation();
    const a = b.dataset.a, id = b.dataset.id;
    if(a === 'new') stkItemForm(); else if(a === 'in') stkInForm(id); else if(a === 'bulk') stkBulkForm(); else if(a === 'fire') stkFireForm(id);
    else if(a === 'count') stkCountForm(id); else if(a === 'edit') stkItemForm(stkItem(id)); else if(a === 'seed') stkSeed();
    else if(a === 'rec') stkRecForm(stkProds()[+b.dataset.i]);
    else if(a === 'del'){ const x = stkItem(id); if(x && confirm(x.name + ' silinsin mi? Reçetelerden de çıkarılır.')){ STK.items = STK.items.filter(y => y.id !== id); Object.keys(STK.rec).forEach(k => { STK.rec[k] = STK.rec[k].filter(r => r.id !== id); if(!STK.rec[k].length) delete STK.rec[k]; }); stkSave(); } }
    else if(a === 'csv'){ const { rows } = stkAgg(); downloadFile('stok-rapor-' + stkR.f + '_' + stkR.t + '.csv', csvOf([['Malzeme', 'Birim', 'Tüketim', 'Tüketim maliyeti', 'Fire', 'Fire maliyeti', 'Alım', 'Güncel stok']].concat(rows.map(o => [o.x.name, o.x.unit, o.s, o.sc.toFixed(2), o.f, o.fc.toFixed(2), o.b, o.x.qty])))); }
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('change', e => { const r = e.target.dataset && e.target.dataset.r; if(r && e.target.closest('#screen-stok') && e.target.value){ stkR[r] = e.target.value; stkRender(); } });
  // ---- uygulama ile bağlantı: kayıt/senkron, ekran yönlendirme, satış kancası ----
  const _snap = snapshot; snapshot = function(){ const o = _snap.apply(this, arguments); o.stock = Object.assign({}, STK, { prod: skPack() }); return o; };
  const _apply = applyState; applyState = function(s, p){
    if(s && s.stock && typeof s.stock === 'object'){ STK.items = Array.isArray(s.stock.items) ? s.stock.items : []; STK.rec = s.stock.rec && typeof s.stock.rec === 'object' ? s.stock.rec : {}; STK.log = Array.isArray(s.stock.log) ? s.stock.log : [];
      STK.prod = {}; arr(s.stock.prod).forEach(x => { if(x && x.n) STK.prod[x.n] = { q: +x.q || 0, min: (x.m == null ? undefined : +x.m) }; });
      STK.plog = Array.isArray(s.stock.plog) ? s.stock.plog.filter(Boolean) : []; STK.pset = Object.assign({ cust: 'out', staff: true, block: true, low: 5 }, (s.stock.pset && typeof s.stock.pset === 'object') ? s.stock.pset : {}); }
    const r = _apply.apply(this, arguments); stkBadge(); return r;
  };
  const _lp = logPriv; logPriv = function(k, e){ if(k === 'saleLog'){ try{ stkConsume(e); }catch(err){ console.error(err); } } return _lp.apply(this, arguments); };
  const _show = showScreen; showScreen = function(n){ const r = _show.apply(this, arguments); if(n === 'stok') stkRender(); return r; };
  titles.stok = 'Stok'; SCR_PERM.stok = 'stock';
  setInterval(stkBadge, 4000);

  // ======================================================================
  // CANLI ÜRÜN STOĞU — menüdeki ürünler üzerinden adet takibi, sade ve canlı
  // ======================================================================
  const SK_LBL = { in: 'Giriş', out: 'Çıkış', sale: 'Satış', set: 'Sayım', start: 'Takip başladı', stop: 'Takip bitti' };
  const skInt = v => { const n = parseInt(String(v).replace(',', '.'), 10); return isFinite(n) ? n : NaN; };
  const skEsc = x => esc(String(x == null ? '' : x));
  const stkTracked = n => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(STK.prod, n);
  const stkLow = n => { const t = STK.prod[n]; return (t && isFinite(t.min) && t.min !== null && t.min !== '') ? +t.min : (+STK.pset.low || 5); };
  function stkReserved(n){ let q = 0; Object.keys(carts).forEach(k => (carts[k] || []).forEach(it => { if(it && it.name === n) q += (+it.qty || 0); })); return q; }
  function stkAvail(n){ return stkTracked(n) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(STK.prod[n].q) - stkReserved(n)) : null; }
  function stkStatus(n, av){ av = av == null ? stkAvail(n) : av; return av <= 0 ? ['bad', 'Tükendi'] : av <= stkLow(n) ? ['warn', 'Azalıyor'] : ['ok', 'Yeterli']; }
  function stkPMove(n, d, t, note){
    const x = STK.prod[n]; if(!x || !isFinite(d)) return;
    const nq = Math.max(0, Math.round((x.q + d) * 1000) / 1000), real = nq - x.q; x.q = nq;
    if(real !== 0 || t === 'start' || t === 'stop') STK.plog.push({ ts: Date.now(), n, d: real, t, note: note || '', u: uname() });
  }
  function skAll(){
    const a = [], seen = new Set();
    categories.forEach(c => (c.products || []).forEach(p => { if(p && p.name && !seen.has(p.name)){ seen.add(p.name); a.push({ p, cat: c.grp || c.name }); } }));
    return a;
  }
  const skSee = () => !!(curUser && (curUser.admin || can('stock') || STK.pset.staff !== false));
  const skChip = n => { if(!stkTracked(n) || !skSee()) return ''; const av = stkAvail(n), s = stkStatus(n, av); return '<span class="sk-mini ' + s[0] + '">' + (av <= 0 ? 'Tükendi' : av + ' adet') + '</span>'; };
  function stkPublic(){
    const P = STK.pset, o = [], l = [];
    if(P.cust === 'hide') return { m: 'hide' };
    Object.keys(STK.prod).forEach(n => { const av = stkAvail(n); if(av <= 0) o.push(n); else if(P.cust === 'low' && av <= stkLow(n)) l.push({ n, q: av }); });
    return { m: P.cust === 'low' ? 'low' : 'out', b: P.block ? 1 : 0, o, l };
  }
  let _skPubSig = '', _skPubFail = 0;
  function stkPushPublic(){
    if(RT.local || !staffMode || !curUser || Date.now() - _skPubFail < 60000) return;
    let d; try{ d = stkPublic(); }catch(e){ return; }
    const sig = JSON.stringify(d); if(sig === _skPubSig) return; _skPubSig = sig;
    try{ Promise.resolve(RT.set('public/stock', d)).catch(() => { _skPubFail = Date.now(); _skPubSig = ''; }); }catch(e){ _skPubFail = Date.now(); }
  }
  function skSave(){ stkBadge(); saveState(); stkRender(); try{ stkPushPublic(); }catch(e){} }
  // ---- görünümler ----
  function skModesUI(){
    const adv = stkMode === 'adv', live = $id('stkLive'); if(!live) return;
    live.style.display = adv ? 'none' : ''; $id('stkAdv').style.display = adv ? '' : 'none';
    $id('stkHeadLive').style.display = adv ? 'none' : ''; $id('stkHeadAdv').style.display = adv ? '' : 'none';
    document.querySelectorAll('#stkModes button').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.sm === stkMode));
    const p = $id('stkSub'); if(p) p.textContent = adv ? 'Malzeme stokları, reçeteler, fire ve tüketim raporları' : 'Ürünlerinizin canlı adet stoğu';
  }
  function skStatusCard(n){ const av = stkAvail(n), s = stkStatus(n, av); return { av, s }; }
  function skGridHtml(){
    const q = skF.q.trim().toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR');
    let L = skAll().filter(x => (!skF.cat || x.cat === skF.cat) && (!q || x.p.name.toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR').includes(q)));
    const sev = n => { const s = stkStatus(n)[0]; return s === 'bad' ? 0 : s === 'warn' ? 1 : 2; };
    if(skF.f === 'untracked') L = L.filter(x => !stkTracked(x.p.name));
    else{
      L = L.filter(x => stkTracked(x.p.name));
      if(skF.f === 'low') L = L.filter(x => stkStatus(x.p.name)[0] === 'warn');
      if(skF.f === 'out') L = L.filter(x => stkStatus(x.p.name)[0] === 'bad');
      L.sort((a, b) => sev(a.p.name) - sev(b.p.name) || a.p.name.localeCompare(b.p.name, 'tr'));
    }
    if(!L.length){
      const none = !Object.keys(STK.prod).length && !skF.q && !skF.cat && skF.f === 'tracked';
      return '<div class="sk-empty"><div class="sk-ei">📦</div><b>' + (none ? 'Stok takibi henüz başlamadı' : 'Bu görünümde ürün yok') + '</b><p>' + (none ? 'Ürünleri menüdeki gibi seçin, adetlerini yazın; satış yapıldıkça stok kendiliğinden düşer.' : 'Filtreyi veya aramayı değiştirin.') + '</p>' + (none ? '<button class="sk-primary" data-sa="add">＋ Stok ekle</button>' : '') + '</div>';
    }
    return '<div class="sk-grid">' + L.map(x => {
      const p = x.p, n = p.name, tr = stkTracked(n), en = skEsc(n);
      if(!tr) return '<div class="sk-card off"><div class="sk-top"><div class="sk-vis">' + visHtml(p, '', 'v-mp') + '</div><div class="sk-nm"><b>' + en + '</b><small>' + skEsc(x.cat) + '</small></div></div><div class="sk-nt">Stok takibi kapalı</div><div class="sk-act"><button class="sk-btn" data-sa="on" data-n="' + en + '">Takibe al</button></div></div>';
      const { av, s } = skStatusCard(n), q = Math.floor(STK.prod[n].q), rs = stkReserved(n), lo = stkLow(n), pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, av / Math.max(lo * 3, 1) * 100));
      return '<div class="sk-card ' + s[0] + '"><div class="sk-top"><div class="sk-vis">' + visHtml(p, '', 'v-mp') + '</div><div class="sk-nm"><b>' + en + '</b><small>' + skEsc(x.cat) + '</small></div><span class="sk-pill ' + s[0] + '">' + s[1] + '</span></div>' +
        '<div class="sk-q"><b>' + q + '</b><span>adet</span>' + (rs ? '<em>' + rs + ' adisyonda</em>' : '') + '</div><div class="sk-bar"><i class="' + s[0] + '" style="width:' + pct + '%"></i></div>' +
        '<div class="sk-act"><button class="sk-sq" data-sa="dec" data-n="' + en + '" aria-label="Azalt">−</button><button class="sk-sq" data-sa="inc" data-n="' + en + '" aria-label="Artır">＋</button><button class="sk-btn" data-sa="set" data-n="' + en + '">Sayım</button><button class="sk-btn ghost" data-sa="off" data-n="' + en + '" title="Takibi bırak">⋯</button></div></div>';
    }).join('') + '</div>';
  }
  function skVisPanel(){
    const P = STK.pset, can2 = !!(curUser && (curUser.admin || can('settings'))), dis = can2 ? '' : ' disabled';
    const seg = (k, t) => '<button class="' + (P.cust === k ? 'on' : '') + '" data-sa="cust:' + k + '"' + dis + '>' + t + '</button>';
    const tg = (k, t, d) => '<div class="sk-row"><div><b>' + t + '</b><small>' + d + '</small></div><button class="sk-tg ' + (P[k] !== false && P[k] ? 'on' : '') + '" data-sa="tg:' + k + '"' + dis + ' role="switch" aria-checked="' + !!P[k] + '"><i></i></button></div>';
    return '<div class="sk-vp"><div class="sk-vph"><b>Stok görünürlüğü</b><small>' + (can2 ? 'Stoğun kime ve nasıl gösterileceğini seçin.' : 'Bu ayarları yalnızca yönetici değiştirebilir.') + '</small></div>' +
      '<div class="sk-row col"><div><b>Müşteri menüsünde</b><small>Müşteri sipariş verirken ürünün durumunu görür.</small></div><div class="sk-seg">' + seg('hide', 'Gösterme') + seg('out', '“Tükendi”') + seg('low', 'Tükendi + Son adetler') + '</div></div>' +
      tg('staff', 'Personel ekranlarında stok görünsün', 'Kapalıysa yalnızca stok yetkisi olanlar görür.') + tg('block', 'Tükenen ürün sipariş edilemesin', 'Hem müşteri hem personel tükenen ürünü ekleyemez.') +
      '<div class="sk-row"><div><b>Azalıyor uyarısı</b><small>Bu adedin altına inen ürün “Azalıyor” olur.</small></div><input type="number" min="1" max="999" class="sk-num" id="skLow" value="' + (+P.low || 5) + '"' + dis + '></div></div>';
  }
  function skLiveView(){
    const all = skAll(), tr = all.filter(x => stkTracked(x.p.name)), st = x => stkStatus(x.p.name)[0];
    const nW = tr.filter(x => st(x) === 'warn').length, nB = tr.filter(x => st(x) === 'bad').length, cats = []; all.forEach(x => { if(cats.indexOf(x.cat) < 0) cats.push(x.cat); });
    const fb = (k, t) => '<button class="' + (skF.f === k ? 'on' : '') + '" data-sf="' + k + '">' + t + '</button>';
    return '<div class="sk-kpis"><div class="sk-kpi"><small>Takipteki ürün</small><b>' + tr.length + '</b></div><div class="sk-kpi warn"><small>Azalan</small><b>' + nW + '</b></div><div class="sk-kpi bad"><small>Tükenen</small><b>' + nB + '</b></div></div>' +
      (skVis ? skVisPanel() : '') +
      '<div class="sk-tools"><input id="skSearch" class="sk-search" type="search" placeholder="Ürün ara…" value="' + skEsc(skF.q) + '" autocomplete="off"><div class="sk-seg">' + fb('tracked', 'Takipte') + fb('low', 'Azalan') + fb('out', 'Tükenen') + fb('untracked', 'Takipte değil') + '</div></div>' +
      '<div class="sk-chips"><button class="sk-chip ' + (!skF.cat ? 'on' : '') + '" data-sc="">Tümü</button>' + cats.map(c => '<button class="sk-chip ' + (skF.cat === c ? 'on' : '') + '" data-sc="' + skEsc(c) + '">' + skEsc(c) + '</button>').join('') + '</div><div id="skGrid">' + skGridHtml() + '</div>';
  }
  function skLogView(){
    const L = STK.plog.slice(-200).reverse();
    if(!L.length) return '<div class="sk-empty"><div class="sk-ei">🕘</div><b>Henüz hareket yok</b><p>Stok girişleri, sayımlar ve satışlar burada listelenir.</p></div>';
    return '<div class="sk-log">' + L.map(e => '<div class="sk-lr"><div class="sk-ld ' + (e.d > 0 ? 'in' : e.d < 0 ? 'out' : '') + '">' + (e.d > 0 ? '+' : '') + (e.d || 0) + '</div><div class="sk-lm"><b>' + skEsc(e.n) + '</b><small>' + (SK_LBL[e.t] || e.t) + (e.note ? ' · ' + skEsc(e.note) : '') + (e.u ? ' · ' + skEsc(e.u) : '') + '</small></div><time>' + new Date(e.ts).toLocaleString('tr-TR', { day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) + '</time></div>').join('') + '</div>';
  }
  function stkLiveRender(){
    const h = $id('stkLive'); if(!h) return; skModesUI();
    if(stkMode === 'adv') return;
    const keep = document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id === 'skSearch';
    h.innerHTML = stkMode === 'log' ? skLogView() : skLiveView();
    if(keep){ const i = $id('skSearch'); if(i){ i.focus(); i.setSelectionRange(i.value.length, i.value.length); } }
  }
  // ---- "Stok ekle" penceresi: ürünleri menüdeki gibi seç, adedi yaz ----
  function skSheetEl(){ let ov = document.getElementById('skSheet'); if(!ov){ ov = document.createElement('div'); ov.id = 'skSheet'; ov.className = 'sk-ov'; document.body.appendChild(ov); } return ov; }
  function skOpenSheet(){ skSel = {}; skShMode = 'add'; skShQ = ''; skShCat = ''; const ov = skSheetEl(); ov.style.display = 'flex'; skSheetRender(); setTimeout(() => { const i = document.getElementById('skShSearch'); if(i) i.focus(); }, 60); }
  function skCloseSheet(){ const ov = document.getElementById('skSheet'); if(ov) ov.style.display = 'none'; }
  function skShGrid(){
    const q = skShQ.trim().toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR'), L = skAll().filter(x => (!skShCat || x.cat === skShCat) && (!q || x.p.name.toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR').includes(q)));
    if(!L.length) return '<p class="sk-none">Ürün bulunamadı.</p>';
    return L.map(x => {
      const n = x.p.name, en = skEsc(n), on = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(skSel, n), cur = stkTracked(n) ? Math.floor(STK.prod[n].q) + ' adet' : 'takipte değil';
      return '<div class="sk-tile' + (on ? ' on' : '') + '" data-sn="' + en + '"><div class="sk-vis">' + visHtml(x.p, '', 'v-mp') + '</div><b>' + en + '</b><small>Stok: ' + cur + '</small>' +
        (on ? '<div class="sk-tctl"><button data-sp="-1" aria-label="Azalt">−</button><input type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="0" data-sq value="' + skSel[n] + '" aria-label="Adet"><button data-sp="1" aria-label="Artır">＋</button></div>' : '<div class="sk-tctl pick">＋ Seç</div>') + '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }
  function skShSum(){
    const ks = Object.keys(skSel), tot = ks.reduce((a, k) => a + (skSel[k] || 0), 0), b = document.getElementById('skShOk'), s = document.getElementById('skShSum');
    if(s) s.innerHTML = ks.length ? '<b>' + ks.length + ' ürün</b> · ' + (skShMode === 'add' ? 'toplam +' : 'sayım toplamı ') + tot + ' adet' : 'Ürün seçin';
    if(b){ b.disabled = !ks.length; b.textContent = skShMode === 'add' ? 'Stoğa ekle' : 'Sayımı kaydet'; }
  }
  function skSheetRender(){
    const ov = skSheetEl(), cats = []; skAll().forEach(x => { if(cats.indexOf(x.cat) < 0) cats.push(x.cat); });
    const gs = ov.querySelector('#skShGrid'), st = gs ? gs.scrollTop : 0;
    ov.innerHTML = '<div class="sk-sheet" role="dialog" aria-label="Stok ekle"><div class="sk-sh-head"><div><b>' + (skShMode === 'add' ? 'Stok ekle' : 'Stok sayımı') + '</b><small>' + (skShMode === 'add' ? 'Ürünleri menüdeki gibi seçin, eklenecek adedi yazın.' : 'Raftaki gerçek adedi yazın; stok bu sayıya eşitlenir.') + '</small></div><button class="sk-x" data-sx="close" aria-label="Kapat">✕</button></div>' +
      '<div class="sk-seg sk-seg2"><button class="' + (skShMode === 'add' ? 'on' : '') + '" data-sx="m:add">Stoğa ekle</button><button class="' + (skShMode === 'set' ? 'on' : '') + '" data-sx="m:set">Sayıma eşitle</button></div>' +
      '<input id="skShSearch" class="sk-search" type="search" placeholder="Ürün ara…" value="' + skEsc(skShQ) + '" autocomplete="off">' +
      '<div class="sk-chips"><button class="sk-chip ' + (!skShCat ? 'on' : '') + '" data-sx="c:">Tümü</button>' + cats.map(c => '<button class="sk-chip ' + (skShCat === c ? 'on' : '') + '" data-sx="c:' + skEsc(c) + '">' + skEsc(c) + '</button>').join('') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="sk-sh-grid" id="skShGrid">' + skShGrid() + '</div><div class="sk-sh-foot"><div id="skShSum"></div><button class="sk-primary" id="skShOk" data-sx="ok">Stoğa ekle</button></div></div>';
    const g = ov.querySelector('#skShGrid'); if(g) g.scrollTop = st; skShSum();
  }
  function skApply(){
    const ks = Object.keys(skSel); if(!ks.length) return;
    const done = [];
    ks.forEach(n => {
      const q = Math.max(0, skInt(skSel[n]) || 0); if(skShMode === 'add' && q <= 0) return;
      if(!stkTracked(n)){ STK.prod[n] = { q: 0 }; stkPMove(n, 0, 'start'); }
      if(skShMode === 'add') stkPMove(n, q, 'in'); else stkPMove(n, q - STK.prod[n].q, 'set');
      done.push(q + ' ' + n);
    });
    skCloseSheet(); if(!done.length) return; skSave();
    showToast(done.slice(0, 3).join(', ') + (done.length > 3 ? ' +' + (done.length - 3) + ' ürün' : '') + (skShMode === 'add' ? ' stoğa eklendi.' : ' olarak sayıldı.'));
  }
  function skSetForm(n){
    if(!stkTracked(n)) return; const x = STK.prod[n];
    openForm({ title: n, sub: 'Raftaki gerçek adedi yazın; stok bu sayıya eşitlenir.', fields: [
      { id: 'qty', label: 'Mevcut adet', type: 'number', step: '1', value: Math.floor(x.q) },
      { id: 'min', label: 'Azalınca uyar (adet)', type: 'number', step: '1', value: stkLow(n) }
    ], onOk(v){
      const q = skInt(v.qty), m = skInt(v.min);
      if(!(q >= 0)) return 'Adet 0 veya daha büyük olmalı.'; if(!(m >= 0)) return 'Uyarı adedi geçersiz.';
      x.min = m; if(q !== Math.floor(x.q)) stkPMove(n, q - x.q, 'set'); skSave();
    } });
  }
  // ---- olaylar ----
  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const sh = e.target.closest('#skSheet');
    if(sh){
      if(e.target.id === 'skSheet'){ skCloseSheet(); return; }
      const sx = e.target.closest('[data-sx]');
      if(sx){ const v = sx.dataset.sx;
        if(v === 'close') skCloseSheet(); else if(v === 'ok') skApply();
        else if(v.indexOf('m:') === 0){ skShMode = v.slice(2); skSheetRender(); }
        else if(v.indexOf('c:') === 0){ skShCat = v.slice(2); skSheetRender(); }
        return; }
      const tile = e.target.closest('.sk-tile'); if(!tile) return; const n = tile.dataset.sn, sp = e.target.closest('[data-sp]');
      if(e.target.closest('[data-sq]')) return;
      if(sp){ const d = +sp.dataset.sp, cur = skInt(skSel[n]); skSel[n] = Math.max(skShMode === 'add' ? 1 : 0, (isFinite(cur) ? cur : 0) + d); if(skSel[n] === 0 && skShMode === 'add') delete skSel[n]; }
      else if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(skSel, n)){ if(!e.target.closest('.sk-tctl')) delete skSel[n]; }
      else skSel[n] = skShMode === 'add' ? 1 : (stkTracked(n) ? Math.floor(STK.prod[n].q) : 0);
      skSheetRender(); return;
    }
    if(!e.target.closest('#screen-stok')) return;
    const sm = e.target.closest('#stkModes [data-sm]'); if(sm){ stkMode = sm.dataset.sm; stkRender(); return; }
    const sf = e.target.closest('[data-sf]'); if(sf){ skF.f = sf.dataset.sf; stkRender(); return; }
    const sc = e.target.closest('[data-sc]'); if(sc){ skF.cat = sc.dataset.sc; stkRender(); return; }
    const b = e.target.closest('[data-sa]'); if(!b || b.disabled) return; e.stopPropagation();
    const a = b.dataset.sa, n = b.dataset.n;
    if(a === 'add') skOpenSheet();
    else if(a === 'vis'){ skVis = !skVis; stkRender(); }
    else if(a === 'inc' && stkTracked(n)){ stkPMove(n, 1, 'in'); skSave(); }
    else if(a === 'dec' && stkTracked(n)){ stkPMove(n, -1, 'out'); skSave(); }
    else if(a === 'set') skSetForm(n);
    else if(a === 'on'){ STK.prod[n] = { q: 0 }; stkPMove(n, 0, 'start'); skSave(); skSetForm(n); }
    else if(a === 'off' && stkTracked(n)){ if(confirm(n + ' için stok takibi bırakılsın mı? Ürün normal şekilde satılmaya devam eder.')){ stkPMove(n, 0, 'stop'); delete STK.prod[n]; skSave(); } }
    else if(a.indexOf('cust:') === 0){ STK.pset.cust = a.slice(5); skSave(); }
    else if(a.indexOf('tg:') === 0){ const k = a.slice(3); STK.pset[k] = !STK.pset[k]; skSave(); }
  }, true);
  document.addEventListener('input', e => {
    if(e.target.id === 'skSearch'){ skF.q = e.target.value; const g = $id('skGrid'); if(g) g.innerHTML = skGridHtml(); return; }
    if(e.target.id === 'skShSearch'){ skShQ = e.target.value; const g = document.getElementById('skShGrid'); if(g) g.innerHTML = skShGrid(); return; }
    if(e.target.matches && e.target.matches('#skSheet [data-sq]')){ const t = e.target.closest('.sk-tile'); if(t){ const v = skInt(e.target.value); skSel[t.dataset.sn] = isFinite(v) ? Math.max(0, v) : 0; skShSum(); } }
  });
  document.addEventListener('change', e => { if(e.target.id === 'skLow' && e.target.closest('#screen-stok')){ const v = skInt(e.target.value); if(v >= 1 && v <= 999){ STK.pset.low = v; skSave(); } else e.target.value = STK.pset.low; } });
  // ---- stil ----
  (function(){
    const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = `
.stk2 .sk-seg{display:inline-flex;background:rgba(120,120,128,.13);border-radius:12px;padding:3px;gap:2px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stk2 .sk-seg button,.sk-ov .sk-seg button{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-dim,#666);padding:7px 13px;border-radius:10px;font:600 .85rem inherit;cursor:pointer}
.stk2 .sk-seg button.on,.sk-ov .sk-seg button.on{background:var(--panel,#fff);color:var(--ink,#222);box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.14)}
.stk2 .sk-seg button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
#stkModes{margin:4px 0 16px}
.sk-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.sk-kpi{border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e3e3);background:var(--panel,#fff);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px}.sk-kpi small{display:block;color:var(--ink-dim,#777);font-size:.76rem}.sk-kpi b{font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1.2}
.sk-kpi.warn b{color:#d98c00}.sk-kpi.bad b{color:#d64545}
.sk-tools{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.sk-search{flex:1;min-width:150px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line,#ddd);border-radius:12px;background:var(--panel,#fff);color:inherit;font:inherit;box-sizing:border-box}
.sk-chips{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding:2px 0 8px;margin-bottom:6px;scrollbar-width:none}.sk-chips::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.sk-chip{white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid var(--line,#ddd);background:var(--panel,#fff);color:inherit;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 13px;font:500 .82rem inherit;cursor:pointer}
.sk-chip.on{background:var(--ink,#222);color:var(--panel,#fff);border-color:transparent}
.sk-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(215px,1fr));gap:12px}
.sk-card{border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e3e3);background:var(--panel,#fff);border-radius:16px;padding:13px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;transition:box-shadow .15s}
.sk-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.07)}.sk-card.off{opacity:.7}
.sk-card.bad{border-color:rgba(214,69,69,.4)}.sk-card.warn{border-color:rgba(217,140,0,.4)}
.sk-top{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}.sk-vis{width:46px;height:46px;flex:0 0 46px;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.sk-vis .vis{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;min-height:0!important;border-radius:12px;aspect-ratio:auto}
.sk-nm{flex:1;min-width:0}.sk-nm b{display:block;font-size:.93rem;line-height:1.25;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical}.sk-nm small{color:var(--ink-faint,#999);font-size:.74rem}
.sk-pill{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}
.sk-pill.ok{background:rgba(31,157,106,.14);color:#1f9d6a}.sk-pill.warn{background:rgba(217,140,0,.16);color:#c07a00}.sk-pill.bad{background:rgba(214,69,69,.15);color:#d64545}
.sk-q{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px}.sk-q b{font-size:2rem;line-height:1}.sk-q span{color:var(--ink-dim,#777);font-size:.85rem}.sk-q em{margin-left:auto;font-style:normal;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--ink-faint,#999)}
.sk-bar{height:6px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(120,120,128,.15);overflow:hidden}.sk-bar i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:6px}
.sk-bar i.ok{background:#1f9d6a}.sk-bar i.warn{background:#e0a100}.sk-bar i.bad{background:#d64545}
.sk-act{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}.sk-nt{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ink-faint,#999)}
.sk-sq{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid var(--line,#ddd);background:var(--panel,#fff);color:inherit;font-size:1.15rem;cursor:pointer}
.sk-btn{border:1px solid var(--line,#ddd);background:var(--panel,#fff);color:inherit;border-radius:11px;padding:0 14px;height:38px;font:600 .84rem inherit;cursor:pointer}.sk-btn.ghost{margin-left:auto;padding:0 12px}
.sk-sq:hover,.sk-btn:hover{border-color:var(--ink-dim,#999)}
.sk-primary{border:0;background:var(--red,#cf2e2e);color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 20px;font:700 .92rem inherit;cursor:pointer}.sk-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.sk-empty{text-align:center;padding:42px 16px;color:var(--ink-dim,#777)}.sk-empty b{display:block;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--ink,#222);margin:6px 0 4px}.sk-empty p{max-width:380px;margin:0 auto 16px;font-size:.88rem}.sk-ei{font-size:2.4rem}
.sk-vp{border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e3e3);background:var(--panel,#fff);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:14px}.sk-vph{margin-bottom:6px}.sk-vph small{display:block;color:var(--ink-faint,#999);font-size:.78rem}
.sk-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#eee)}.sk-row.col{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.sk-row small{display:block;color:var(--ink-faint,#999);font-size:.76rem;margin-top:2px}
.sk-tg{width:46px;height:26px;border-radius:99px;border:0;background:rgba(120,120,128,.3);position:relative;cursor:pointer;flex:0 0 46px;transition:background .15s}
.sk-tg i{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.3);transition:left .15s}.sk-tg.on{background:#1f9d6a}.sk-tg.on i{left:23px}.sk-tg:disabled{opacity:.5}
.sk-num{width:78px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--line,#ddd);border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel,#fff);color:inherit;font:inherit;text-align:center}
.sk-log{border:1px solid var(--line,#e3e3e3);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel,#fff)}
.sk-lr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:11px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#eee)}.sk-lr:first-child{border-top:0}
.sk-ld{min-width:52px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(120,120,128,.13)}.sk-ld.in{background:rgba(31,157,106,.14);color:#1f9d6a}.sk-ld.out{background:rgba(214,69,69,.13);color:#d64545}
.sk-lm{flex:1;min-width:0}.sk-lm small{display:block;color:var(--ink-faint,#999);font-size:.76rem}.sk-lr time{color:var(--ink-faint,#999);font-size:.76rem;white-space:nowrap}
.sk-ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);z-index:2500;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px}
.sk-sheet{background:var(--panel,#fff);color:var(--ink,#222);width:100%;max-width:860px;max-height:92vh;border-radius:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:18px;gap:10px;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.sk-sh-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}.sk-sh-head b{font-size:1.15rem}.sk-sh-head small{display:block;color:var(--ink-faint,#888);font-size:.8rem;margin-top:2px}
.sk-x{border:0;background:rgba(120,120,128,.15);width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;color:inherit;font-size:1rem}
.sk-seg2{align-self:flex-start}
.sk-sheet{height:min(92vh,900px);height:min(92dvh,900px);overflow:hidden}
.sk-sheet>.sk-sh-head,.sk-sheet>.sk-seg2,.sk-sheet>.sk-search,.sk-sheet>.sk-chips,.sk-sheet>.sk-sh-foot{flex:0 0 auto}
.sk-sheet>.sk-chips{position:relative;z-index:2;min-height:40px}
.sk-sheet .sk-sh-grid{flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
@media(max-width:560px){.sk-sheet{height:96vh;height:96dvh}}
.sk-sh-grid{flex:1;overflow:auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px;padding:2px;align-content:start;min-height:180px}
.sk-tile{border:1.5px solid var(--line,#e3e3e3);border-radius:14px;padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--panel,#fff)}
.sk-tile .sk-vis{width:100%;height:78px;flex:none}.sk-tile b{font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.25;min-height:2.1em}.sk-tile small{color:var(--ink-faint,#999);font-size:.72rem}
.sk-tile.on{border-color:var(--red,#cf2e2e);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(207,46,46,.12)}
.sk-tctl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-top:2px}.sk-tctl.pick{justify-content:center;color:var(--red,#cf2e2e);font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;padding:6px 0}
.sk-tctl button{width:30px;height:32px;border:1px solid var(--line,#ddd);background:var(--panel,#fff);color:inherit;border-radius:9px;font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer}
.sk-tctl input{flex:1;min-width:0;width:100%;height:32px;border:1px solid var(--line,#ddd);border-radius:9px;text-align:center;font:700 .95rem inherit;background:var(--panel,#fff);color:inherit}
.sk-sh-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#eee);padding-top:12px}#skShSum{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink-dim,#666)}
.sk-none{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;color:var(--ink-faint,#999);padding:30px 0}
.sk-mini{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:999px;z-index:2;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.sk-mini.ok{background:rgba(31,157,106,.9);color:#fff}.sk-mini.warn{background:rgba(224,161,0,.95);color:#fff}.sk-mini.bad{background:rgba(214,69,69,.95);color:#fff}
.mp-card{position:relative}
.c-item{position:relative}.c-stk{display:inline-block;margin-top:4px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:999px}
.c-stk.out{background:rgba(214,69,69,.14);color:#d64545}.c-stk.low{background:rgba(224,161,0,.18);color:#b57d00}
.c-item.c-out .vis{filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.55}.c-item.c-out .nm b{opacity:.6}.c-soldout{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:#d64545}
@media(max-width:560px){.sk-kpis{gap:8px}.sk-kpi{padding:10px}.sk-kpi b{font-size:1.35rem}.sk-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.sk-sheet{max-height:96vh;padding:14px}.sk-sh-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.sk-tools .sk-seg{width:100%}}
`; document.head.appendChild(st);
  })();

  const skPack = () => Object.keys(STK.prod).map(n => ({ n, q: STK.prod[n].q, m: (STK.prod[n].min == null || !isFinite(STK.prod[n].min)) ? null : STK.prod[n].min }));
  function custStk(n){
    const pd = getPub(), st = pd && pd.stock; if(!st || !st.m || st.m === 'hide') return null;
    if(arr(st.o).indexOf(n) >= 0) return { out: 1, b: st.b };
    const l = arr(st.l).find(x => x && x.n === n); if(st.m === 'low' && l) return { left: +l.q, b: st.b };
    return null;
  }
  const _ssv = saveState; saveState = function(){ const r = _ssv.apply(this, arguments); try{ stkPushPublic(); }catch(e){} return r; };
  setInterval(() => { try{ const sc = $id('screen-stok'), a = document.activeElement, sh = document.getElementById('skSheet'); if(sc && sc.offsetParent && stkMode !== 'adv' && !(a && /INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(a.tagName)) && !(sh && sh.style.display === 'flex')) stkLiveRender(); }catch(e){} }, 5000);

  smFullApply('siparis-masa');
  bootApp();
</script>
<script id="themeXJs">
/* ===== TEMA betiği: yalnızca simge/başlık gibi görsel öğeleri günceller; iş mantığına dokunmaz ===== */
(function(){
  const NAV = {home:'home','siparis-masa':'shopping_basket',mutfak:'restaurant',urunler:'restaurant_menu',digitalmenu:'vibration',musteriler:'assignment_ind',stok:'inventory_2',ciro:'show_chart','rapor-gunsonu':'point_of_sale',gider:'trending_down',zayi:'delete_outline','rapor-urun':'bar_chart','rapor-vardiya':'description','rapor-personel':'groups','rapor-istatistik':'pie_chart','rapor-fire':'local_fire_department',tables:'grid_view',users:'people',perms:'verified_user',ai:'auto_awesome',istekler:'inbox',settings:'settings',birimler:'straighten',ozellikler:'list',kdv:'percent',indirimler:'sell',mutfakgruplari:'soup_kitchen',odenmezler:'money_off'};
  const FOLD = { rapor: 'bar_chart', tanim: 'playlist_add_check' };
  const GRP = { 'Günlük işler': 'layers', 'Menü ve müşteri': 'assignment', 'Kasa ve raporlar': 'pie_chart', 'Yönetim': 'manage_accounts' };
  const SW = ['layers', 'groups', 'bar_chart', 'swap_vert'];
  const mi = n => '<i class="mi">' + n + '</i>';
  const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
  function setIcon(el, name){ if(!el || el.dataset.t) return; [...el.childNodes].forEach(n => { if(n.nodeType === 3) n.remove(); }); el.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', mi(name)); el.dataset.t = '1'; }
  function homeClosed(){
    const home = document.getElementById('screen-home'); if(!home) return;
    let box = document.getElementById('homeClosed');
    if(!box){ box = document.createElement('div'); box.id = 'homeClosed'; box.className = 'chart-card'; home.appendChild(box); }
    let adm = false; try{ adm = !!adminDev(); }catch(e){}
    if(!adm){ box.style.display = 'none'; return; }
    box.style.display = '';
    let rows = []; try{ const s0 = dayStart(); rows = saleLog.filter(x => x && !x.reopened && (x.ts || 0) >= s0).sort((a, b) => (b.ts || 0) - (a.ts || 0)); }catch(e){}
    const m = n => { try{ return money(n); }catch(e){ return '₺' + n; } }, e = s => { try{ return esc(String(s)); }catch(_){ return String(s); } };
    const tot = rows.reduce((s, x) => s + (+x.total || 0), 0);
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="hc-head"><b>' + mi('receipt_long') + 'Kapanan Fişler</b><span>' + rows.length + ' fiş · Toplam: ' + m(tot) + '</span></div>' +
      (rows.length ? '<div class="hc-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Fiş No</th><th>Masa</th><th>Garson</th><th>Ödeme tipi</th><th>Saat</th><th>Ürünler</th><th>Tutar</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
        rows.slice(0, 50).map(x => { const pays = [...new Set((x.pays || []).filter(p => p && +p.amount > 0).map(p => String(p.method).replace(/^Açık Hesap · .*/, 'Açık Hesap')))].join(' + ') || '—', its = (x.items || []).map(i => i.qty + '× ' + i.name).join(', '); return '<tr><td>F-' + e(x.adNo || '—') + '</td><td>' + e(x.label || '') + '</td><td>' + e(x.user || '—') + '</td><td>' + e(pays) + '</td><td>' + new Date(x.ts).toLocaleTimeString('tr-TR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) + '</td><td>' + e(its.length > 110 ? its.slice(0, 107) + '…' : its) + '</td><td>' + m(x.total) + '</td></tr>'; }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div>' : '<p style="color:var(--ink-faint);padding:6px 2px 14px;margin:0">Bugün kapanan fiş yok.</p>');
  }
  function apply(){
    const sb = document.querySelector('.sidebar'); if(!sb) return;
    sb.querySelectorAll('.nav-item[data-screen] > .ic').forEach(el => { const k = el.parentElement.dataset.screen; if(NAV[k] && !el.dataset.t){ el.innerHTML = mi(NAV[k]); el.dataset.t = '1'; } });
    sb.querySelectorAll('.nav-fold[data-fold] > .nav-item > .ic').forEach(el => { const k = el.closest('.nav-fold').dataset.fold; if(FOLD[k] && !el.dataset.t){ el.innerHTML = mi(FOLD[k]); el.dataset.t = '1'; } });
    sb.querySelectorAll('.nav-label').forEach(l => { if(l.dataset.t) return; const sp = l.querySelector('span'), ic = sp && GRP[sp.textContent.trim()]; if(ic){ const s = document.createElement('span'); s.className = 'ic'; s.innerHTML = mi(ic); l.insertBefore(s, l.firstChild); } l.dataset.t = '1'; });
    sb.querySelectorAll('.chev').forEach(c => { if(!c.dataset.t){ c.innerHTML = mi('expand_more'); c.dataset.t = '1'; } });
    const top = sb.querySelector('.sb-top');
    if(top && !top.querySelector('.sb-sub')){ const d = document.createElement('div'); d.className = 'sb-sub'; d.id = 'sbSub'; top.appendChild(d); }
    const sub = document.getElementById('sbSub');
    if(sub){ let nm = ''; try{ nm = (settings && settings.restName) || (APP_CONFIG.brand && APP_CONFIG.brand.name) || ''; }catch(e){} if(sub.dataset.n !== nm){ sub.dataset.n = nm; sub.innerHTML = '<span></span><small>v1.0</small>'; sub.firstChild.textContent = nm; } }
    setIcon($('#btnMenu'), 'menu'); setIcon($('#btnRefresh'), 'refresh');
    setIcon($('#btnCO'), 'notifications'); setIcon($('#btnKitchen'), 'restaurant'); setIcon($('#btnUserMenu'), 'more_vert');
    document.querySelectorAll('.screen[id^="screen-"]').forEach(s => { const pi = s.querySelector('.panel-head .pi, .settings-head .icn'); const n = NAV[s.id.slice(7)]; if(pi && n && !pi.dataset.t){ pi.innerHTML = mi(n); pi.dataset.t = '1'; } });
    document.querySelectorAll('#screen-home .stat-card .swatch').forEach((s, i) => { if(!s.dataset.t){ s.innerHTML = mi(SW[i] || 'insights'); s.dataset.t = '1'; } });
    try{ homeClosed(); }catch(e){}
  }
  let tm = 0; new MutationObserver(() => { clearTimeout(tm); tm = setTimeout(apply, 50); }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  try{ const u = updateHomeStats; updateHomeStats = function(){ const r = u.apply(this, arguments); try{ homeClosed(); }catch(e){} return r; }; }catch(e){}
  document.addEventListener('click', e => { const b = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('#btnMenu'); if(b && window.innerWidth >= 900){ document.body.classList.toggle('sb-collapsed'); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); } }, true);
  apply();
})();

</script>
</body>
